RENAMED, because the old names did not survive scrutiny. ALL POOLS leaned on "pool", which is internal jargon - the tabs and the funnel key both call these things families, and what you want named is what is in the chart. PNL vs DD was worse: BOTH charts plot profit against drawdown, so it did not tell them apart. They are now RISK MAP (the scatter) and RANKED (the bar list), titled ALL CANDIDATES.

The colour keys on both charts are now CLICKABLE. Click a family to hide it; click again to bring it back. Everything re-fits to what is left - the axes, the trend line and the bar dollar scale - so hiding the family that was stretching an axis actually gives the rest of the points room instead of just blanking some dots. FIX on RANKED: the drawdown bar and the profit bar now sit on ONE line, sharing a single band and baseline. The previous pass put them in the top and bottom half of one track, which still read as two rows. On a candidate that lost money - the only case where both bars run the same way - the drawdown is drawn as a hollow outline with the loss bar solid inside it, so an overlap reads as one bar inside another.

New SHOW toggle on RANKED: BOTH / NET / DD. On BOTH the two halves share one dollar scale, so bar lengths are directly comparable - honest, but it does squash the drawdowns into stubs whenever profit dwarfs them (yes, the drawdown bars really did shrink, and that is why). Picking NET or DD isolates one and re-fits the scale to it, so its own spread fills the track and can be read properly. The scale in force is named under the bars.

FIX: the 73.55 change that made RAW follow the SAMPLE tick only ever worked on runs produced by the newest engine - which is every run you have NOT got. On run #225 and every other existing run the RAW tab still showed the same pinned whole-window MAR, SHARPE and DD no matter what you ticked, so RAW-LB could never be compared with GATE-LB.

MAR, SHARPE and DD now follow the SAMPLE tick on OLD runs too. Those four read off the saved equity curves, which every run carries, so nothing newer is needed. PF, WIN % and $ / TRADE genuinely cannot be sliced from a curve - they need per-trade win/loss sums the older runs never saved. Rather than print an IS+WF number under an LB label, those three now show a dash on an old run whenever the tick is not exactly IS+WF, the section caption says so out loud, and hovering the dash explains why.

Also fixed while in there: DD and $ / TRADE printed point counts rather than dollars on the newest-engine path, the drawdown of a stretch missed the give-back after the last sampled point on the curve, and an IS-only or WF-only pick now uses the drawdown the engine actually measured for that stretch instead of estimating it.

FIX on the ALL POOLS chart just shipped: it was being stretched to fill its tile, which squashed it sideways and stretched it tall - the dots came out as ovals rather than circles, and worse, the trend line LOOKED like a different slope than the one it was actually measured at, so you could not read a dot honestly against the two axes. It now keeps its true shape at whatever width the column is. Trade-off worth knowing: this one chart no longer has a drag handle to pull it taller, because its height is now fixed by its width.

FIX, the ALL POOLS dots really were not coloured. Three of the four pools were painted from THEME colours rather than fixed ones, and on the MONO theme the whole palette is grey - so RAW, GATE and TILT all came out the same grey and only HYBRID kept any colour. All four now use the exact colours the 1A FUNNEL key already paints them: RAW green, GATE red, TILT amber, HYBRID violet. Same colour for a family in both charts, on every theme.

ALL POOLS has real axes now: a drawn x and y axis with tick marks and five labelled dollar values on each, named axis titles (NET PNL up the side, DD along the bottom), and a dashed trend line through the cloud - labelled with how many dollars of net it adds per $1 of extra drawdown and an r-squared, so a flat, meaningless trend says so out loud instead of looking like a finding.

PNL vs DD is ONE row per candidate now, not two. Its name, its drawdown in dollars, both bars sharing one centreline, and its net in dollars all sit on a single line - and both bars are drawn to ONE dollar scale, so a bar twice as long really is twice the money. A candidate that lost money draws its net bar leftward, alongside its drawdown.

Both charts now carry the SAMPLE toggles (IS / WF / LB) on the chart itself, so you can see which stretch of the run you are looking at without hunting for it. They are the same toggles the 1E MATRIX tables use, so ticking one here moves the tables too and the two can never disagree.

HOTFIX: the previous release (73.62) crashed the run report for every Auto-Validate run - a variable the new 1A tabs needed was declared inside the wrong code block, so it was undefined by the time 1A tried to read it. Fixed - reports render normally again.
The ALL POOLS PnL-vs-drawdown scatter moved out of 1E MATRIX and into 1A, as its own tab next to CHAMPION and FUNNEL - it no longer sits pinned above the RAW/GATE/TILT/HYBRID tables.
New PNL vs DD tab right next to it in 1A: the same all-pool candidates as horizontal bars instead of dots - one row per candidate, PnL and drawdown sharing a centreline, sorted best PnL first.

FIX: HYBRID pool candidates in that chart were rendering colorless (grey) instead of their assigned color, and clicking one did not jump to its matrix row either. Both now work - the color table needed the long pool name, not the short internal key.

1E MATRIX gets a new ALL POOLS scatter, above the RAW/GATE/TILT/HYBRID tab tables: every candidate from all four pools plotted together (drawdown vs net $, colour-coded by pool), scoped to whatever SAMPLE is ticked, so an outlier the pre-registered net-$ + MAR-floor rule rejected is still there to eyeball. Hover a dot for its label and exact $/DD; click one to jump to its column in the matrix below.

SAMPLE-scope audit across §1E MATRIX (owner: "switching between tabs shouldn’t change metric behavior"). GATE’s SHARPE row silently measured the WHOLE saved equity curve on every tick combo except exactly PRE-LOCKBOX or LOCKBOX alone (IS alone, WF alone, IS+WF, WF+LB all fell through to the whole curve while the row header still named the ticked stretch) — it now reads the same contiguous span the DD row already cuts to, on every combo, and honestly dashes on the one combo DD also can’t span (IS+LB with WF unticked).

RAW’s SHARPE row was permanently pinned to the whole optimize window (IS+WF) no matter what was ticked, and combined-scope DD (e.g. IS+WF, or WF+LB) used a "deepest individual slice" approximation marked with a °. Runs saved before this engine change (no is_rng/wf_rng/lockbox) keep the exact old pinned display.
TILT and HYBRID were already correctly scope-following (their own _shrp already fraction-splits by ticked stretch) — audited, no leak found, no change needed there.

PAPER now has a LEG rail next to REFRESH - ALL / ORB / ENGU-Q / NOISE / BLEND - and picking one narrows the WHOLE board to that strategy: its tile, its curve line, its trades. ALL is the default and behaves exactly as before.
Same control language as the report layout rail, and it is a lens rather than a saved setting - it resets when you reload.

NEO now follows your theme instead of forcing its own teal - every glow, hairline, grid line and tint is derived from the active theme accent, so on MONO the whole report reads as pure silver-on-black with zero added color; green themes look as before and other accents follow suit.

NEO pushed further (NEO only - CLASSIC untouched): HUD-style section headers in uppercase with wide tracking and squared number chips, more air between sections, wider title letter-spacing, the 1A champion card wears a stronger accent ring, faint zebra striping on plain table rows, soft hover transitions, and the back-to-checklist hint only appears when you hover a section header.

New NEO report layout - the run report wearing a modern skin: deep glass panels, neon hairline dividers, a faint blueprint-grid backdrop, glowing section rules, calmer table chrome and slim accent scrollbars. Pick it from the layout rail in the report header, next to CLASSIC and DASHBOARD.

Nothing moved and nothing was rebuilt - NEO is the same charts, sections, drag splitters, saved sizes and COLUMNS control as CLASSIC, so the two views can never drift apart. CLASSIC itself is untouched; flip back any time.

Trade scores now have a home in the repo instead of living inline. The judgement sits in tools/data/trade_scores.json and tools/trade_scores.py rebuilds the block in this file, so adding a scored trade no longer means hand-editing the app.
The 1-minute bars behind each score report are cached alongside it, so a trade stays scorable after it ages out of the free 30-day intraday window.
No change to what you see - the scores and charts are identical to 73.28.

The score report now opens with a candlestick chart of the bars around your fill instead of pure text. The breakout candle is boxed, entry / exit / stop are drawn across it, and the shaded band is the CHASE - the gap between the breakout candle close and where you actually filled.
Seven more stock trades scored: AMC, GMM, SUGP, LGCL, LHAI, CELZ, TNMG. Eleven of the twenty-three are now scored - the rest are older than the free intraday history reaches.
Sort the SCORE column to rank every scored trade.

New SCORE column in TRADING LOG > TRADES, next to GRADE. Click the pill for a full score report: two separate marks out of 100 - SETUP (everything knowable before the fill) and EXECUTION (graded against the tape afterwards) - with every factor, its weight and the measurement behind it.

The report also shows the entry geometry: breakout candle, its close, your CHASE % (how far above that close you filled, as a share of the candle range), stop, risk, reward, R multiple, how much of the planned risk the drawdown ate, and how much of the favourable move you kept.
First four stock trades scored: EHGO 82, XRX 61, OFAL 51, LABT 38. Sort the column to rank them.

Picking a built-in logo mark no longer loses the image you uploaded. The last uploaded logo is kept aside and a RESTORE UPLOADED button with a thumbnail appears next to it in Settings > APPEARANCE > LOGO, so you can try the marks and go back.

FIX (owner): switching settings panes moved the whole window around the screen. The window sized itself to whichever pane you were on, so APPEARANCE and TRADING LOG were different heights and the box jumped when you clicked between them. It is now one fixed size for every pane - nothing moves.

NEW LOGOS (owner ask). ONE SETTINGS SCREEN (owner ask - tired of having two settings spots). The TRADING LOG > SETTINGS tab and the BACKTESTER > SETTINGS subtab are both gone. Everything now lives in a single master settings window opened by the gear in the top right, reachable from any tab on either side of the app.

The window is split by type down a left rail: APPEARANCE (theme, density, logo - applies to the whole app), TRADING LOG (setup types, tags, per-instrument fees, account balances, account info), BACKTESTER (run defaults, runner, reconciler, AI providers, auto-pull, synced counts) and ABOUT (version + full changelog, which used to be a sub-tab of the backtester settings).

Esc or a click outside closes it. Editing a setting that redraws the app (theme, adding a setup, saving a balance) now refreshes the window in place instead of leaving it showing the pre-edit state, and it keeps your scroll position.
A browser that had the old SETTINGS tab saved as its last view is sent to OVERVIEW (or LIBRARY on the backtester side) instead of landing on a tab that no longer has a button.

FIX on 73.20: dragging the price scale changed nothing. The drag was being tracked but the new scale was never handed to the chart, so it redrew at the old one. Verified working - the axis numbers now compress and expand as you drag.

CANDLE CHART, three owner asks. POSITION BOX: a trade now draws as a box from the entry bar to the exit bar spanning entry price to exit price, green if it made money and red if it lost, with the entry level dashed across it. On a one or two bar trade the old arrow-and-dot labels landed on top of each other and were unreadable; the labels now sit outside the box, flip to the other side near the right edge so they cannot run off, and get pushed apart when the two prices are nearly the same.

DRAG THE PRICE SCALE. Grab the dollar numbers on the right and drag up to stretch the prices apart or down to squash them together. The axis used to auto-fit the bars on screen with no way to override it, so a quiet stretch filled the height and a big move flattened everything around it. Works whether or not you have zoomed the time axis; double-click resets both.

CANDLES ARE EASIER TO TELL APART, especially on the monochrome theme where up and down were two shades of grey. Up bars are now hollow and down bars solid, so the shape says which is which and brightness is no longer doing all the work. Same on every theme - it is the standard candle convention.

PAPER candle window now says PAPER SHADOW TRADE in its subtitle instead of champion config, and repeats the look-ahead warning on an ORB row - a paper trade is not a run champion and should not read like one.

CANDLES ON THE PAPER TAB (owner ask). Every row of the PAPER trades table now has a CHART button that opens that trade as a real price chart - the session it happened in plus the session either side, the session VWAP, the bars you were in the trade shaded, and the entry and exit marked at their fill prices. Same window as the run blotter, so PREV and NEXT step through the paper trades and the arrow keys work.

These trades are newer than any saved price file on your PC, so the chart is built from the master plus the live feed the shadow runner itself uses. That means the candles you see are the same bars the paper trade was decided on.

The three legs run on different timeframes - ORB and NOISE on 5 minute bars, ENGU-Q on 1 minute - and each row now fetches its own, so an ENGU-Q trade opens at 1 minute rather than borrowing the wrong chart.
Coverage caveat: the live feed only started recording partway through 2026-08-10, so a chart of the earliest paper days can begin mid-session rather than at the open.

Library: archived the leak-compromised touch-entry ORB family (ORB 2.0/3.0/3.1/3.2/3.3 and forks, 21 files) plus VWAP FADE 2.0, per the look-ahead audit and fill-realism sweep. ORB 3.5, ORB 3.1 125C, ORB FADE 1.0, ORB 1.0, NOISE 1.0 and the ENGU-Q files are unaffected and stay active.

The BOOKS table in COMPARE was flagging the saved book rows for a look-ahead ORB leg but not the LIVE BOOK RUN rows, so the top row could show an ORB book at full net with no warning. Live book runs now carry the same flag.
FILL-REALISM SWEEP. Audited all 60 strategy files for the same bug class as the ORB look-ahead: a simulated fill that used something nobody could have known yet. Fixed 13 files.
The BOOKS table in COMPARE now flags every book that contains an ORB leg, champion row included. Those net dollar figures are not live-achievable and the row now says so.
Three files were handing back invented profit factors and drawdowns without simulating a single trade. They now refuse to run instead of returning fiction.
Eleven strategies were paying the exact stop price even when the bar opened straight past it. They now fill at the open on a gap, which is what a real stop order does.
The VWAP FADE pair aimed its exit at a price that was partly built from the same bar it was being tested against. The target is now the level as it stood when the bar opened.
New push gate: any strategy file you change is checked for these mistakes before it can be pushed.

Results ▸ 2B CONFIGS: a run scored before the 2026-08-10 gate look-ahead fix now shows an amber PRE-FIX ML pill next to the GATE / TILT / HYBRID tabs, so old inflated numbers are not mistaken for causal ones. Re-run Auto-Validate to get a clean read.
The TILT tab now carries a permanent notice: TILT is retired, 0 of 12 tilts cleared the pre-registered bar on causal scores (2026-08-10) - shown for reference only, do not adopt.

PAPER - the LIVE row (NinjaTrader demo fills) now counts from 2026-08-12 only, excluding the 2026-08-11 shakedown trade (wrong session template, -650). That first day is still visible in its own daily report.

PAPER - NOISE joins the shadow board as a third leg, ORB shadow line is badged as engine reference only (its volume filter is look-ahead), and a new LIVE row shows the NinjaTrader demo account fills next to the shadow numbers.

The FAMILY chip row was listing individual strategy VERSIONS alongside the real families - eight extra chips like ENGU 1.3.5 plus a no-label one. It shows the same nine families the Past Runs tab does and nothing else.

RUNBOARD has FAMILY chips now, the same quick-toggle the Past Runs tab carries. Click ORB and the whole board - funnel, matrix and list - reloads with the top ORB runs instead of one champion per strategy, ranked by whatever RANK BY and SAMPLE are set to. Click it again, or all, to go back. That is how you compare a strategy against its own other configs.

The expanded funnel no longer offers CHAMPION and CONFIG FUNNEL tabs. Those belong to a run report, where the curves ARE configs of one run and champion means that run crowned config. On the RUNBOARD every curve is a different STRATEGY, so a raw config view could not mean anything.

FIX (owner-reported): the expanded 1A funnel used to open with every RAW config AND the whole OTHER RAW grey cloud switched on at once, which lagged badly. It now opens with just one line per section - the crowned RAW config, the chosen gate, the picked tilt, the picked hybrid, the picked hybrid recycle - and nothing from OTHER RAW by default. Every other line is one click away in its group.

Verified while in there: the HYBRID / HYBRID RECYCLE key rows already toggle their own lines correctly (fixed last version, 73.7) - the default-visibility pick above now reuses that exact same per-section ranking instead of a separate one, so the two can never disagree.

FIX (owner-reported): in the expanded funnel, clicking the HYBRID or HYBRID recycle key row greyed out the OTHER RAW cloud instead of the hybrids. Those two families got their own key rows a while back but the click handler was never told about them, so both fell through to the last group in an old three-way branch. Every family now cycles its own lines.
FIX: the OTHER RAW row printed the ending dollars of whichever grey line happened to be first in memory, presented as the group best. It now reads the best one, like every other row.

FIX: the key rows were ORDERED by each family best line but each row PRINTS the line the funnel actually draws. When those differed the key sat in an order its own figures did not explain. Both read the same line now.

The hover figures moved INTO the key. Mousing across the funnel used to open a second box in the top right corner listing every strategy value, which covered the chart. Each key row now shows that strategy dollars AT THE CURSOR instead, swapping back to its ending figure when you move off.
DOUBLE-CLICK anywhere on the funnel opens the expanded explorer, the same gesture the report chart uses. Double-clicking a key row still only works the key.

FIX on the new BOOK picker: GATE was re-deriving a DEFAULT model instead of the gate this run actually crowned - on run 203 it answered with logistic at 0.5 when the run crowns xgb at 0.45. The blotter now hands your PC the run own crowned model and cut-off, so the GATE / TILT / HYBRID books you see are the ones the report is talking about.

THE BLOTTER CAN NOW SHOW THE GATE, TILT AND HYBRID BOOKS, not just the crowned RAW config (owner ask). Pick RAW / GATE / TILT / HYBRID under the view switch: trades the gate would SKIP grey out and say SKIP, sized books show the size each trade gets, and the line above reports how many trades that book takes and what it does to the net.
These per-trade answers are NOT stored in the run - the run only ever saved the totals - so your PC re-derives them on demand, about 40 seconds for a 5,600-trade run.
Checked against the run own saved gate result before shipping: on run 203 the recomputed gate keeps 2,959 trades for 24,809.87 points, matching the saved figures exactly.
Every candle chart opened from the blotter still draws the same real bars - the book only changes which trades are taken and at what size.

Cut-off sweep chart (1E GATE tab): the dashed hindsight curves are OFF by default and no longer stretch the y-axis. That was why the chart looked squashed on run 203 - one held-out year ran far past the tuning years and flattened every line that actually made the decision. A HINDSIGHT chip turns them back on when you want them.
The solid/dashed key, the hindsight warning and the hover tip moved off the caption and into the info icon.
The LB HELD chip under the sweep chart is gone - the gate verdict reads off the 2A funnel as a line, and the sentence now lives in the tab info icon and the section 3 GATE VALIDATE pill.

Greying a strategy on the funnel key now fades its DRAWDOWN trace too. The equity line went faint but its underwater shading stayed at full strength, so a greyed strategy was still shouting from the lower pane.

PAPER Layer 1 - NinjaTrader Sim101 auto-trading strategies added to the repo (tools/nt): EdgeLogORB30 and EdgeLogENGUQ1m, ports of the two crowned configs the shadow trader runs, plus a setup checklist (SIM101_SETUP.md). No app change - compile and enable them inside NinjaTrader; their Sim101 fills flow into the trade log automatically.

Ship tool fixes (dev-side, no UI change) - the version-realign step no longer skips silently on Windows, so a push can never step the site version backward again; and the pre-push boot gate now tests the worktree copy of the site that is actually being pushed, not the shared checkout.

PAPER - the load error under the board is actually gone now. The 72.7 attempt still tripped the same database requirement; the daily-reports list now fetches the last 60 days of reports the plain way and sorts them newest-first itself.

PAPER - fixed the load error that appeared under the board. The daily-reports list was asking the database for newest-first in a way that needs a special index; it now asks oldest-first and flips the list itself, which needs nothing extra.

PAPER view v1 — live forward-test board. New Backtester sub-tab PAPER shows the shadow trades the runner logs each day for ORB, ENGU-Q and the 1:1 BLEND: per-leg tiles (days live, trades, net dollars, win rate, last trade), a cumulative PnL curve, a trades table and a daily reports list with per-leg warnings and the reviewed verdict. No real money — shadow trading starts 2026-08-11.

FOUND IT - the HYBRID and HYBRID-recycle lines were never drawn in the expanded 1A because the equity draw order simply did not include those two families. Their right-edge pills and drawdown strips come from loops over every series, which is why you saw the pill and no line. Both families are in the draw order now, painted on top like the tilts.

Expanded key group headers now quote the same line the tile draws - so GATES reads the chosen gate figure (the one on the funnel gutter pill), not whichever hidden candidate happened to finish highest.

FIX: drag-to-pan on the gallery charts did nothing. Every pan redraws the chart, which swaps the drawing out from under the mouse, and the old handler lost the gesture the instant that happened. The drag is now pinned to the chart you grabbed, so it pans smoothly the whole way.
CHART GALLERY - the mouse wheel scrolls the LIST again. Zooming a chart now takes CTRL (or Shift) plus the wheel, because a plain wheel belongs to the list you are scrolling.
CHART GALLERY - click and DRAG a zoomed chart to pan it, the way you would on TradingView. The cursor turns to a grab hand on any chart that is zoomed in.
SAVING - every card has its own PNG button, and a SAVE ALL button at the top prints just the charts, so your browser Save as PDF gives you the whole set in one file.

The gate sweep chart says IS + WF on the plot itself now, in the same words the rest of the report uses, instead of only in the axis title and a line underneath. The caption below it shortens to the one thing the plot cannot say: the matrix above totals whatever SAMPLE is ticked, so with LB ticked it reads higher by exactly the held-out year.

The GATE SWEEP CHART has its own Y AXIS switch - MAR or NET $ - sitting on the chart itself. It used to follow the RANK button, which is a control for ordering matrix COLUMNS, so changing what the chart measured meant reaching for something that looks like it does something else entirely. Until the new switch is touched it still follows RANK, so nothing moves unless you ask it to.

Said plainly on the chart: every figure on it covers the TUNING YEARS ONLY - in-sample plus walk-forward - because that is all the pick was allowed to see. The GATE matrix above it totals whatever SAMPLE is ticked, so with LB ticked it reads higher by exactly the held-out year. Same model, same cut-off, different stretch. That is why rf at 50 percent can read 499k on the chart and 580k in the matrix, and both be correct. The axis title, the hover and a line under the chart all now say so.

The GREY step of the key cycle now actually greys the line. The click was recording the state but the chart was still drawing that strategy at full strength, so grey and shown looked identical. All three segments of a curve fade together.

Hotfix: the funnel key came up blank on 72.6 - the three-state click landed but the setting it reads was never created. Key rows are back and the cycle works: click greys a strategy out, click again removes it, once more brings it back.

RUNBOARD funnel key rows CYCLE three states on click now, instead of only deleting. First click GREYS the strategy out - it stays on the chart, faint, and still counts toward the scale so you keep the context. Second click REMOVES it. Third brings it back. The report funnel greys its non-survivors the same way.
The expand button opens the fullscreen explorer with what is actually on screen. A greyed or removed strategy no longer reappears at full strength just because you expanded the chart.
The HWM chip was lighting up one click behind what the chart was drawing - the setting was being read after the title row had already been built.

RUNBOARD funnel: the blue walk-forward and purple lockbox SHADING is gone. Every strategy reaches its own walk-forward and lockbox on a different date, so one shared band drew boundaries that were true for at most one curve and wrong for the rest - a strategy still in walk-forward appeared to be sitting inside the lockbox. Each line states its own stages instead: solid in-sample, dashed walk-forward, dotted lockbox, the same line procedure every other PnL chart on the site uses.
The word DRAWDOWN sat on the top edge of the drawdown pane and the filled area sliced it in half. It sits above the pane now.

NEW HWM toggle on the funnel title. It draws each line HIGH-WATER MARK - the running peak, the most that strategy had ever made up to that point. The gap between a line and its own mark is the drawdown it was sitting in right then, so a long flat mark with the line beneath it reads as a long stretch under water. Off by default, remembered once set.

1A EXPANDED NOW MIRRORS THE TILE BY CONSTRUCTION. The tile draws one line per family - the best tilt, the best hybrid, its recycle, the chosen gate - and the payload builder now stamps those exact objects, so the explorer opens with the same lines visible in the same pure colours (amber, violet, pink, red). Before, each family opened on whichever line finished highest - often a dark shade variant - while the tile line stayed hidden. That mismatch is why colours kept looking wrong and lines kept looking missing no matter how many palettes were corrected.
The best hybrid recycle line now uses the tile own redeploy factor, so it ends exactly on the H-recycle gutter pill figure instead of a ratio computed from a different field.

HOVERING THE KEY now does exactly what hovering a line does - that strategy lifts, every other one fades, in the chart and in the matrix. It was already wired but the plot was fighting it: the key sits inside the chart area, so moving onto a key row also counted as moving over the plot, and the plot immediately cleared the highlight the key had just set.
The in-sample, walk-forward and lockbox line-style rows are off the RUNBOARD key. The info icon covers them and they were taking three rows of a small box.
PRICE SCALE MOVED TO THE RIGHT on every candle chart, the side every trading platform puts it on. The left gutter it used to sit in was dead space.

THE GALLERY IS NOW A WORKING SURFACE, not thumbnails: roll the wheel over ANY chart in the list to zoom its price action in place, double-click to reset, and each card carries its own TRADE and FULL buttons plus a live bar count. You no longer have to open a chart to study it.
CANDLE WINDOW header tidied: flatter controls, tighter row, and the price readout moved onto its own quiet line under a divider instead of competing with the buttons.
The tick-box fix in 71.98 only reached one of the two pickers. Both the ADD RUNS list and the book picker have proper tick boxes now instead of ones stretched across a quarter of the row.

FIXED the ADD RUNS dialog, which rendered as a column of stretched tick boxes with the text flung to the right. The app-wide input rule sets every input to full width with big padding and the tick boxes were inheriting it. They opt out now, and the book picker had the same bug.
The dashed purple line down the middle of the funnel is gone.
The in-sample then blue band then purple lockbox line is off the funnel title - the info icon already covers it.

Each funnel key row carries the SAME rank as its matrix column now - R1, R2 and so on - so the chart and the table read as one board. A strategy with no saved curve was quietly shifting the key out of step with the ranks.

1A expanded key: the GATES group read BLUE while the funnel drew the gate RED. The group swatch comes from its first member, and the 21 gate CANDIDATES were still on the ML model palette - only the chosen line had been moved. All of them now shade off the same funnel red, so the group reads as one family.
Switching CHAMPION / FUNNEL in the expanded view no longer flashes the bare report at you. The swap - close, re-render, re-open - is covered by a single veil so it reads as one transition.
1E SIZE tabs: the permanent caption line and the COMPARISON ONLY chip are behind the info icon now instead of taking a row under every table. Same for the three HYBRID modes.

GATE SWEEP CHART now reads out on hover. Move across it and every model prints its MAR and its net dollars at that exact 1 percent cut-off, tuning years. Both measures were already saved at every step - the chart was only ever drawing whichever one the RANK button selected - so the peaks can now be priced without flipping RANK back and forth.

A BOOK run names itself. Run 204 was reading 7 - ORB 3.0 in every run list, because a book has no single strategy file and the family matcher fell back to the closest name it could find. Book rows now show the book mark and the book name.
And a book no longer prints NaN in the ROBUSTNESS column. A book tunes nothing, so that score was never defined for it - it shows a dash, like the walk-forward column next to it already does.
Opening a LOOK-ALIKE group as charts now names that group at the top instead of the generic MOST RECENT heading, and the view switch is hidden since the set is already fixed to that group.

Fix: the CHAMPION / FUNNEL tabs were dead when you opened the CHAMPION chart first. The code that wires them only came into existence once the funnel explorer had been opened at least once, so whichever chart you expanded first got two painted but unclickable tabs.
LOOK-ALIKE SETUPS: the win-rate chip was multiplying an already-finished percentage, so a 36 percent group printed 3610 percent. Reads correctly now.

HOTFIX: every run report died with "Cannot access _actSel before initialization" - the new header action tray was a const that could be read before its initializer ran. It is a hoisted function now, which cannot land in that state.

CRITICAL FIX: EVERY run report has been failing to open since 71.90 - the panel just said the run detail could not render. The header rebuild in that version accidentally absorbed the line that starts the report header, leaving that block referring to itself. Reports open again.

NEW - LOOK-ALIKE SETUPS (owner idea): a button on the blotter that hunts for trades whose price action BEFORE the entry is near-identical, the setups that look copy-pasted. Your PC strips out price level and volatility so only the SHAPE is compared, then groups everything 97 percent alike or better. Each group shows how many trades, how alike they are, the average result, the win rate and a sketch of the shared shape - and SEE THESE CHARTS stacks that group in the gallery so you can eyeball them side by side.

It tells you when a group is just luck. With thousands of trades there are millions of pairs, so some look-alikes are guaranteed by chance. Every group is tested against shuffled data and corrected for the number of groups tested at once - only the ones that survive are tagged SIGNAL, everything else says CHANCE.
This needs the PC runner restarted once to answer the new request.

CONFIG COLOURS, THE REST OF IT. The funnel key paints GATE red, TILT amber, HYBRID violet and HYBRID recycle pink - but the expanded explorer was painting those same four curves from the ML MODEL palette instead, so the lines you pick out of the funnel by colour arrived expanded wearing different ones. Each family now keeps its funnel colour; extra variants of a family step darker off the same hue so they stay separable.
The CHAMPION expanded view now has the CHAMPION / FUNNEL tabs too, so the switch works both ways instead of only funnel to champion.

The four run actions at the end of the report header - note, re-label, archive, delete - are one tinted tray of borderless icon chips now, matching the REPORT LAYOUT and COLUMNS rails beside them. Delete carries its red on the icon instead of a permanent red box.
Follow-up to 71.85: the line naming which short-window strategies were hidden was being built but never attached, so the board dropped them silently. It prints under the list now.
RUNBOARD layout: 1A FUNNEL on the left, 1E MATRIX on the right, and the strategy list with TOP 10 stacked together in one bar on the far right.

Strategies whose best run covers under two years are DROPPED from the board rather than sorted last - nineteen days does not compare with sixteen years, and showing it only invited the comparison. The count and the run numbers are named under the list, and TOP 10 still reaches them.
Highlighting reaches ACROSS panels: hover a curve in the funnel and that strategy column lifts in the matrix while the rest of the table fades. Hovering its key row does the same.

New + ADD button on the funnel. The board picks one run per strategy automatically - its best - so this is how you put ANY other config on the chart. Ticked runs join as their own line and column, ten columns maximum, and the picks are remembered. Clear them from the same row.
Every walk-forward stripe now says what that fold actually made - dollars, profit factor and trades for the strategy leading the board.
BACK buttons: the candle window and the chart gallery both open with a BACK button now, so you step out to whatever you came from instead of hunting for CLOSE.
TOP 10 sets grow: a +10 MORE button appears in the candle window while you are inside a top-10 set, extending it to the top 20, 30 and so on with the new charts pre-loading in the background.

BLOTTER WINDOW CLEANED UP (owner: too much text, confusing): the run-on header sentence is gone. The facts are chips now - trade count, NET dollars, win rate, master, how many are showing - the four views are ONE segmented switch (RECENT / WINS / LOSSES / ALL), the paging button is a simple +25, and the hint sentences moved onto hover.
Hotfix on the new CHART GALLERY: it opened UNDERNEATH the blotter window instead of on top of it, so it looked like nothing happened. It sits above now.

CHART GALLERY (owner ask): a CHARTS OF THIS VIEW button on the blotter now stacks a REAL candle chart for every trade in the current view - top wins, top losses or most recent - in ONE scrollable window, all fetched at once instead of one trade at a time. LOAD 10 MORE keeps going past the first ten, and the header counts them in as they land.
Each gallery chart has an OPEN button that hands that trade to the full CANDLES window for zoom, save and stepping. Anything already viewed draws instantly - the two share one cache.
FIXED: clicking ALL in the blotter dumped every one of the 5,616 rows in one go, which shoved the view controls off the screen. ALL is paged now, same LOAD 25 MORE as RECENT.

Fix: the CHAMPION / FUNNEL tabs in the expanded 1A now actually switch. Two faults, both fixed: the handler was calling the top-level savePref and renderApp rather than the report renderer versions, so the choice was never stored; and clicking the cards own tab button in the same instant as the modal close hit a node the re-render had already thrown away. It now waits for the close, re-finds the live button, and re-opens the chart as soon as it exists.

SPOTLIGHT on the funnel: hover a curve and it lifts while every other one drops to a faint trace, in the plot and in the key at the same time. Hovering a key row does the same thing. Moving off clears it.
The key box was set at 7.5px, below what the mono font renders cleanly - that is why it looked pixelated. It is 9px now with more line spacing.
The paragraphs under the funnel and under the matrix are gone. Both are summarised behind the info icon on the title instead.
GRAPH DETAIL slider removed.

Runs with no walk-forward and no lockbox - plain Auto-Optimize runs like 42, 60 and 74 - were showing dashes for profit factor, win rate and Sharpe on the whole-run view. Those runs never split their window, so the optimize window IS the whole run and their own figures were already the right answer. They fill in now.

FIXED FOR REAL - config colours no longer change when you expand the 1A funnel. The cause was the LOCKBOX CONTINUATION tails: they were painted from their own two-colour orange/purple alternation that knew nothing about the config palette, so a config rode a teal line to the lockbox door and then finished the run in orange. The expanded explorer draws one continuous line per config, so it disagreed. Each tail now inherits its own config colour.

Fix: clicking CHAMPION or FUNNEL in the expanded 1A no longer throws you back to the top of RESULTS. The tab switch re-renders the report, which reset the page scroll - your position is now restored, and the chart re-opens as soon as it exists instead of after a fixed delay that could fire too early and open nothing.

SECTION 2 REGROUPED BY CHART TYPE (owner). Three named columns: DISTRIBUTIONS (2A config spread, 2B trade-PnL spread, 2C MAE/MFE, 2D deflated Sharpe), SURFACES and CURVES (2E 3-D explorer, 2F parallel coordinates, 2G PDP top-out curves), BARS and TABLES (2H knob importance, 2I neighbours, 2J regime card, 2K trade context, 2L ML config builder, 2M top configs). Section 1 is untouched.

The CONFIG DISTRIBUTION now leads section 2 directly above the TRADE-PNL DISTRIBUTION - the two spread charts read as a pair - so it takes the first letter of the section, 2A. Every tile that had moved down from section 1 takes a section-2 letter too, so no tile in section 2 is labelled 1-anything any more.

The ROBUSTNESS and DIAGNOSTICS pills are now a vertical rail pinned to the right of section 2 instead of a wide grid below it. Clicking a pill still opens its full readout in the section below, which is where the tables have room.
Fix: the distribution stack could render TWICE - once in section 1 and again in section 2 - on runs with no second 1E matrix card. It now renders in exactly one place.

Fix: in the expanded 1A explorer, the CHAMPION and FUNNEL tabs were completely dead - the code that wired them up read a variable that does not exist in that function, so it threw before attaching a single handler. They switch now, and the report re-renders first so the chart being re-opened is actually in the page.

FIXED: reading the OHLC line moved the chart. The window sized itself to whatever text sat inside it, so every hover swapped a short hint for a long price line and the chart jumped and resized with it - measured at 39 pixels of resize and a 20 pixel shift per hover. The window now has a fixed width and the readout line a fixed height, so hovering moves NOTHING.
Same fix keeps the chart the same size from one trade to the next while stepping with PREV / NEXT.
Hotfix: opening COMPARE threw and left the tab blank on 71.77. The strategy list was reading the TOP 10 setting one step before that setting was created. Nothing else changed.
TOP 10 now sits UNDER the RUNBOARD list in the left column instead of taking a fourth column of its own. Both lists cap their height when it is open so the pair still fits one screen.

RUNBOARD funnel picked up the report chart furniture it was missing: an info icon that opens the full explanation, a GRAPH DETAIL slider that thins the drawn line without touching any total, hover text on every walk-forward stripe and on the lockbox wash, and a dashed line marking the deepest drawdown on show with its dollar figure on the axis.

The dashed line style is not decoration: solid is in-sample, dashed is walk-forward, dotted is the lockbox. That is the same line procedure the report funnel uses, so a glance tells you which part of a curve was tuned and which part was not.
RUNBOARD has a + TOP 10 button next to the mode pills. It opens a FOURTH panel on the right listing ten individual runs, with tabs for BEST, WORST and RECENT.

BEST and WORST rank on the same metric and the same stretch the RANK BY and SAMPLE tabs are set to, so the list always answers the question the board is currently asking. RECENT ignores both and just lists the newest runs. Click any row to open that run report.

This is the one place on the board that shows INDIVIDUAL runs. The other three panels only ever show one run per strategy - its champion - so every other run a strategy has made is invisible there. Short-sample runs still carry their warning mark and are pushed to the bottom of BEST.

CANDLE WINDOW mouse controls now match TradingView (owner: "moving the mouse around changes the chart"): DRAGGING no longer zoom-selects - the mouse WHEEL zooms the bars around the cursor, DRAG pans the zoomed view, DOUBLE-CLICK shows everything. The old behavior fired a zoom on the pan gesture every chart trains your hand to make.

TOP 10 menu: picking any trade now loads ALL TEN of that list up front and PREV / NEXT / arrow keys page through just those ten - the readout shows "3 / 10 - TOP 10 WINNERS - loading 7/10" until the set is in. "Back to table order" in the same menu returns to normal stepping.

RUNBOARD funnel: the walk-forward region draws as ALTERNATING FOLD STRIPES now, one stripe per fold, the way 1A and the config funnel in the results tab both do it - so you can count the test windows straight off the chart. It was one flat blue wash before, which was the most obvious difference between this chart and the report one.

1E pickers now wear the same look as the report header controls. The tab strip and the SAMPLE, RANK and HEAT rows were bordered chips and open-topped folder tabs; they are tinted trays with a filled, underlined active segment now - the same rail the CLASSIC and COLUMNS controls use - so the whole report speaks one control language.

RUNBOARD heat map is RANK based now, so EVERY column gets a colour. Shading by raw value let one freak number own the whole scale - a 19-day run scoring a MAR of 1400 pushed every real strategy to the same red - so short-window columns had to be cut out of the scale and left grey, and that grey is what read as columns not being heat mapped. Ranking each column against the others is immune to outliers: everything with a number gets its own shade, ties share one.

The reward and risk band is filled in. Whole-run profit factor and win rate were blank on every run except a book. They are recoverable the same way the run report builds them - profit factor by pooling the stages rather than averaging ratios, win rate and Sharpe from the whole-window figures the validate already saves - and SHARPE is now a row, like it is on the 1E card.

The metric column says the window ONCE, on the band caption, instead of repeating it on every row. A row only names a window of its own when it genuinely measures a different one: FOLDS HELD is always walk-forward and ROBUSTNESS is always whole-run.

RUNBOARD panel split: only a real DRAG pins it now. A click on a divider that never moved was saving the current widths as a fixed split, quietly freezing the three panels at whatever size they happened to be - which is how the matrix could end up narrower than its own table on a later visit and look cramped for no reason. A click with no drag now clears the pin and goes back to the automatic sizing.

FIX on 71.67: clicking the new 1A ▦ TRADES tab while the card was on FUNNEL popped a blocking browser alert that froze the whole page until dismissed. The tab now carries its own blotter payload so it works from BOTH card tabs, and that alert is gone for good - a run without a payload just dims the tab with the reason on hover.

RUNBOARD metric names and their order now match the 1E card. 1E lists the stage money rows first and then TOTAL as the summary - it does not lead with a total and indent children under it. So the rows read IS dollars, WF dollars, LB dollars, then TOTAL.
It says DD, not MAX DD, for the same reason the 1E card was renamed: a drawdown measured on one stretch is not the maximum drawdown of the whole run.
The stage-lit row is replaced by FOLDS HELD, the row 1E actually carries. A book shows a dash there and says why on hover - it tunes nothing, so it has no folds to hold by design.

SAMPLE, RANK and HEAT moved off the far right. They were pinned to the tile right edge, and now that the table sizes to its own content the tile is often much wider than the table - so the controls were stranding themselves hundreds of pixels from the thing they control. They sit on their own line under the title, reading left to right like the table below them.

CONFIG COLOURS MATCH between the 1A tile and its expanded view. The tile painted the walk-forward survivors from an eight-hue palette while the expanded explorer painted the very same configs from a teal ramp - two different palettes for one set of lines, so a config you were following changed colour the moment you expanded the chart. The tile choice is now handed to the explorer, so both draw the same config in the same colour. The crowned line stays green and the in-sample best stays blue in both.

1A card grows a ▦ TRADES tab (next to CHAMPION / FUNNEL): opens the champion trade blotter in its OWN window - no chart expansion needed. Same quick views, same CHART pill per row into the full candle viewer (prev/next, top 10, zoom, save).

BLOTTER QUICK VIEWS (both the new window and the expanded-1A panel): RECENT (10 newest, LOAD 25 MORE), TOP 10 WINS, TOP 10 LOSSES, and ALL. RECENT is the default - the panel no longer renders five thousand rows up front; ALL is one click.

NO MORE WAITING BEHIND A BACKTEST: your PC now answers candle and blotter fetches on a separate lane, in parallel with a running job - a fetch lands in seconds instead of queueing behind a 30-90 minute backtest. (Takes effect at the next runner restart, done.)

RUNBOARD column width, second pass. Handing the spare width to the metric-name column left a wide empty gap down the middle of the table, which was worse than the columns being padded. The table now sizes to its content and stops: every column is as wide as its own numbers, and any leftover width sits outside the table where it belongs. Drag the panel divider in if you want it gone entirely.

The CHAMPION and FUNNEL tabs in the expanded view moved next to the EQUITY COMPARE title. They were tucked in beside RESET at the far right of a very wide header row, which on a normal window is past the edge of the screen - which is why they could not be found.

And the expanded key is ranked like the tile key: the family groups are ordered by where each one FINISHES, best first, instead of a fixed RAW, GATES, TILTS, HYBRID order. The two keys now read top to bottom the same way.

RUNBOARD columns are no longer padded out. A table narrower than its panel was spreading the spare width evenly, so eight short numeric columns each sat at about 130 pixels when their contents needed half that. The data columns now shrink to what they actually hold and the metric names absorb the slack, so the table still fills the panel but the numbers sit close together the way they do on the 1E card.

RUNBOARD columns narrowed. The head now reads exactly like a 1E head - a crown on the leader, the rank, then the RUN NUMBER - with the strategy short name on the line underneath where 1E puts its date range. The long name was on the top line before and it was the single thing forcing every column wider than its numbers needed.
Row names trimmed of the parts that repeated themselves: MAR reads MAR then the stretch instead of naming the same stretch twice, and the ROBUSTNESS and STAGES rows drop their whole-run suffix.
The matrix takes the larger share of the width by default now - it is the panel carrying eight numeric columns. The drag bars still override it and your split is remembered.

EXPANDED 1A can switch charts. CHAMPION and FUNNEL tabs ride the expanded header now - clicking one flips the tile tab and re-opens the expanded view on that chart, so you are no longer stuck with whichever one you happened to open.
COLUMNS picker reads as a caption then plain 3, 2, 1 instead of spelling out 3 COLUMNS on every button.

HOTFIX on 71.60: fresh tabs could boot with an empty RESULTS list - the offline cache layer was deadlocking against older open tabs and silently queueing every read forever. The offline cache is now OFF entirely; every tab talks straight to the server. Only cost: the runs list re-downloads on each page load, which is small. If anything ever hangs again, closing other EDGELOG tabs and reloading is the reset.

CONNECTION FIX for fetches that never came back even though your PC had answered: every open EDGELOG tab was funneling its traffic through ONE elected lead tab, so a single stale tab could starve all of them - each tab now talks to the server on its own. The connection also auto-switches transport when the stream goes quiet. If a fetch ever still hangs, closing OTHER old EDGELOG tabs and reloading this one is the reset.

FUNNEL opens on the top THREE raw configs instead of every stored curve. On a run that saved 400 of them the gate, tilt and hybrid lines were buried under a wall of near-identical raw curves. The configs slider still spans all of them, and a setting you drag yourself still wins.

FIXED the "Document already exists" error on candle / blotter fetches. On a shaky connection the browser retries sending the command to your PC, and the retry was tripping over the first attempt - the fetch had actually gone through, but the window showed a failure. Command sends are retry-proof now.

RUNBOARD heat: a short-window column is left OUT of the colour scale, for the same reason the 1E card drops its ungated baseline out of its own heat - a column that is not a like-for-like comparison drags the scale and paints every real one the same colour. A 19-day run scoring a MAR of 1400 was making all five full-history strategies read red. Those cells still shade, in a muted grey, so they read as measured but deliberately excluded.
The in-sample, walk-forward and lockbox split rows are heat mapped too, like the matching rows on the 1E card.

RUNBOARD matrix now wears the three things that actually make the 1E card look like itself. HEAT: every cell shaded by where it lands across its own row, green best through red worst, with the middle of the pack left quiet - the same shading maths and the same amber HEAT tab the 1E card uses. On by default, and remembered.

Every row NAMES ITS WINDOW, the way 1E rows read PF then the stretch. So a row is NET dollars FULL, MAX DD FULL, MAR FULL divided by FULL DD, and so on - you can never read a number without knowing what it was measured over.

Column heads use the 1E format: a rank number, a crown on the leader, the short name, and the years underneath. Band captions read like 1E too - return then the stretch, reward divided by risk then the stretch, sample, verdict.
CANDLE WINDOW is now a full viewer (owner asks): PREV / NEXT buttons and the LEFT/RIGHT ARROW KEYS step to the neighbouring trade in the blotter current sort order, with a ROW x / y position readout.
TOP 10 menu in the same row jumps straight to any of the ten biggest winners or ten biggest losers of the run.
ZOOM: drag across the candles to zoom to that stretch, the TRADE button zooms to the held window with some context, FULL or a double-click shows everything again.
SAVE PNG downloads the current view as an image, named by run and trade number.
Stepping is fast: each trade bars are kept once fetched, and the two neighbouring trades quietly pre-load in the background while you look at the current one.

RUNBOARD ranking: a run whose window is under two years is now placed LAST no matter what RANK BY says. A 19-day run with a 116 dollar drawdown was scoring a MAR of 1400 and taking the leading column off a sixteen-year book. That is not a comparison, it is dividing by almost nothing. Those runs stay on the board - hiding them would be worse - but they can never head the ranking.

TRADES on the whole-run view is filled in now: the optimize-window count plus the walk-forward out-of-sample counts plus the lockbox count, the same sum the run report KPI matrix adds up. It was showing a dash for everything except books.

RUNBOARD matrix rebuilt to match how 1E is ACTUALLY laid out. 1E is metrics only - no band of text rows at the top. The board was printing Strategy, Market, Scope, Window and Stages as five prose rows, which is what made it read as a wall of text instead of a table you can scan.
A column is now a short name plus the years it covers, and nothing else. Strategy, market, scope and the exact dates are on hover, the way 1E puts its date range under the stage name.

Rows sit in the 1E bands: RETURN with the money row leading and the stage split indented beneath it, then DRAWDOWN, REWARD divided by RISK, EDGE, SAMPLE and VERDICT. FULL now carries MAR, PF, win rate, dollars per trade and trades instead of stopping at the net split.

Honest dashes: only a book records a whole-run profit factor, win rate and dollars per trade, because only a book re-measures its own pooled trades. Every other run shows a dash there rather than borrowing its optimize-window figure and calling it a whole-run number.
ROBUSTNESS was printing NaN on a book run. It shows a dash now - that score was never defined for a book.
A short window is flagged with a yellow warning mark on the column head itself, not just in a row.
BOOKS table fix: every lockbox run was showing up as a book, because the word LOCKBOX contains the letters book. A row is a book only if it actually carries pooled book results now.

BOOK row numbers all describe the SAME stretch. A row was mixing a whole-run net with an in-sample profit factor and in-sample trade count, which reads as nonsense. Net, PF, drawdown, MAR and trades now all come from the stretch the SAMPLE tabs are on.

BOOK legs find their own data now. A saved run does not always record whether it traded the day session or the overnight one, so an overnight leg was being asked for day-session data and the whole book failed with no data for that leg. The book now infers the session from the leg data source and, failing that, tries the alternatives before giving up - and each finished book reports which data each leg actually ran on.

CHART and TRADES fetches now wait up to 5 MINUTES instead of giving up at 90 seconds. When a backtest is running on your PC every fetch queues behind it, and 90s was routinely too short - the wait window kept counting while the fetch had already silently died. The timeout message also says the likely reason now: runner off, or busy with a backtest.

ROOT CAUSE of "stuck on loading" FOUND AND FIXED: when a new version deploys, a tab sitting in the background silently HARD-RELOADS itself - and that wipe was killing your in-flight blotter and candle fetches and closing the expanded view mid-wait. On a day with many deploys it hit constantly. The auto-reload now stands down whenever a PC fetch is in flight or an expanded view is open - you get the green update pill to tap instead, never a silent wipe.

BOOK RUNS ARE REAL NOW. A book - two or more strategies traded side by side in one account - used to be the one thing the app could not measure, because Auto-Validate takes a single strategy file, so those numbers were computed offline and pasted in by hand. Your PC can run a book as an ordinary job: every leg replayed over the same window with its own frozen settings, every trade pooled into one pile, and the pile scored as ONE strategy - so the profit factor and the drawdown are true account numbers, not a legs.

RUNBOARD BOOKS has a + RUN A BOOK button. Tick the strategies you would trade together and it queues the job; the window defaults to the stretch every picked strategy has data for. The finished book saves like any other run - real equity curve, real lockbox read, its own run report - and lands at the top of the BOOKS table marked LIVE RUN. Click the row to open it.

A book carries no walk-forward column on purpose. Nothing is tuned during a book run, so there are no folds to report; what it does carry is the lockbox stretch and the house count of how many of 8 equal stretches were profitable.

QUICK TOGGLE ON THE CHART: click any strategy in the funnel key to drop it out of the chart, click again to bring it back. Hidden strategies stay in the key struck through, and the axis, bands and drawdown pane all rescale to what is left.

CHART button (TRADES blotter row): the candle window now opens INSTANTLY with a live seconds counter and a plain explanation - the bar fetch is a real trip to your PC (~30s, longer if a backtest is running there) and the old tiny hourglass read as stuck. The chart fills in by itself when the bars land.
CHART button: a failed fetch now prints its error inside that same window with a retry hint, instead of a pop-up alert that was easy to dismiss and forget.
TRADES button while loading now ticks elapsed seconds too, so a minutes-long first load reads as alive.

REAL BUG, caught on run 203: TAKEN plus NOT TAKEN did not add up. NOT TAKEN was the refused count for the WHOLE RUN sitting directly under a TRADES row that follows the SAMPLE tick, so on WF+LB the hybrid read 2,222 taken and 2,657 refused - a total larger than the 3,707 trades those two stretches even contain.

Refused is now measured stretch by stretch: the no-filter trade count for each ticked stretch minus what that column kept. On the same run the xgb hybrid now reads 2,222 taken and 1,485 refused, which is exactly the 3,707 the TILT tab shows for WF+LB, since a tilt refuses nothing.

BIGGEST SIZE and SIZE MIX carry a FULL tag now. The engine saves the size profile once for the run rather than per stretch, so those two genuinely cannot follow the tick and they say so instead of looking sample-scoped.

Worth knowing when reconciling: the RAW tab TRADES row is tagged IS+WF and counts one config over the optimize window. It is a different window AND a different book to the filter tabs, so it is not the total those two rows add up to - the TILT TRADES row on the same tick is.

RAW tab has a TRADES row now. The config records were carrying the count all along, the matrix just never printed it - so the tab showed PF, WIN percent and dollars per trade with no sample size under them. It sits with the other optimize-window rows and is tagged IS+WF like they are.

KPI tab now lines up with the rest of 1E. Its group captions and cells were on their own padding rhythm, so every row sat a few pixels off the same row on RAW, GATE, TILT and the hybrids and a tab flip shifted the whole table. Same rhythm everywhere now. Its column headers stay one line taller because each one carries the date range under the stretch name.
No duplicate rows found on KPI - RECOVERY and MAR are genuinely different numbers, net over drawdown versus the annualised version, not the same figure twice.

AVG CONTRACTS only shows when a column is NOT running one lot. On TILT and on the plain HYBRID tab it read 1.00x in every column, which is the definition of those tabs rather than a finding. It still shows on REDEPLOY and EQUAL-DRAWDOWN where it is the whole point.
NOT TAKEN only shows when something was actually refused. A tilt refuses nothing, so that row was a column of zeros on every tilt.
NOT TAKEN now sits directly under TRADES on the tabs that have it. Taken and refused are the same question and they were four rows apart.

WIN % on the TILT tab now shades. It was never being skipped - a tilt refuses no trades, so every column on that tab wins the exact same trades and the row reads one number all the way across. A heat map of a flat row is one uniform colour, and that is what it paints now, instead of leaving the row blank and looking like the shading had missed it. Applies to any flat row on any 1E tab.

1E ROWS LINE UP ACROSS TABS NOW. The wide-table squeeze was tightening rows vertically as well as sideways, so a ten-column TILT drew 15px rows against a five-column HYBRID at 17px and every row shifted when you flipped between them. Only the sideways padding tightens now, so the tabs sit row for row and a flip compares like with like.

SIZE RULE is one line on every tab. The cut-off used to print above the size shape on the HYBRID tabs, making that row nearly twice as tall as the same row on TILT - the single biggest reason the two would not align. Cut-off and shape share one line; the full sentence is still on hover.
TRADES blotter (expanded 1A): the candle button on each row is now a clear bordered CHART pill with a CHART column header - it was a bare candle glyph that was easy to miss entirely.

TRADES button: when a saved blotter auto-opens with the view, the button now lights up blue while the panel is SHOWING - before, clicking it just hid the already-open panel with no hint, which read as the load doing nothing.
TRADES button while loading now says a FIRST load reruns the champion on your PC and can take minutes - the quick reopen is only quick because it restores the saved copy.

RUNBOARD now shows each strategy WINDOW - the dates it covers and how long that is - as its own row on the matrix, and a span under two years is flagged in yellow. A 19-day run was sitting at the top of the board on NET against 16-year runs, and nothing on screen said the samples were different sizes.
The funnel key carries the same span beside each ending dollar figure. That is what the hairline blip on the chart was: a run whose whole window is a few weeks, drawn on a 16-year calendar axis.

Two labels left over from the 71.31 pass. The TILT and HYBRID RETURN headers were still ending in FULL after the FULL row itself was removed, and the GATE total row read as a bare stretch list where every other tab reads TOTAL. Both now say the same thing in the same place: TOTAL followed by the stretches you ticked.

RUNBOARD panels RESIZE now. A drag bar under the funnel and under the matrix sets that panel height, and drag bars BETWEEN the three panels trade width - the same two gestures the run report uses. Every size is remembered; double-click a bar to put it back to default.
RUNBOARD matrix: the stages row is plain text now - IS · WF · LB in their period colours, dimmed when a run never ran that stage - instead of bordered chips. It is called STAGES RUN.
The compare and runboard equity charts are no longer locked to one height.

EVERY 1E ROW NOW MEASURES WHAT THE SAMPLE TABS SAY, AND NOTHING ELSE. The tabs were mixing windows in one table - a sample-scoped row sitting next to a whole-run copy of the same metric - so a number could be read against a neighbour that was measured on a different stretch.

Each RETURN group reads IS, WF, LB as ticked, then TOTAL of exactly those stretches, then the DD of exactly those stretches. Tick all three and TOTAL is the whole run, taken from the engine own whole-run block, so nothing is lost by dropping the old FULL row.
It is called DD now, not MAX DD. A drawdown measured on two of three stretches is not the max drawdown of the run and should not claim to be. The tag next to it names the tick it belongs to.

Gone as duplicates: FULL DOLLARS, FULL MAX DD, FULL MAR, ALL TRADES and the LB TRADES row on the GATE tab. Every one of them was a second copy of a row already on screen, measured on a window you did not pick.
SHARPE on the TILT and HYBRID tabs was quietly measured over the whole run whatever you ticked. It is cut to the ticked stretches now and annualised on that span.

The RAW tab is the one place a metric genuinely cannot follow the tick: a config saved equity curve covers the optimize window only, and the walk-forward folds are scattered THROUGH the in-sample years rather than following them, so there is no IS-only or WF-only curve to measure on. Its dollar rows and TOTAL do follow the tick; DD, MAR, SHARPE, PF, WIN percent and dollars per trade now print their real window in the row label - DD IS+WF, MAR WF over IS+WF DD, and so on - instead of leaving it to a hover.

ONE DRAWDOWN ROW. The TILT and the three HYBRID tabs were printing the drawdown twice - FULL MAX DD up in RETURN and a second MAX DD down in REWARD divided by RISK, on two different windows. There is now a single MAX DD row, measured on whatever SAMPLE is ticked, sitting directly under the stretch dollars it belongs to and labelled with that same tick. Both old rows are gone.
That is the shape the GATE tab already used, so all the drawdown tabs now read the same way: the dollars for the stretches you ticked, then the drawdown it took to earn them, in one place.

The RAW tab keeps its MAX DD tagged IS+WF. A config saved equity curve covers the optimize window only, so a per-stretch drawdown does not exist for those columns - the label says which window it is rather than pretending it follows the tick.

TILT tab: the size shape no longer prints on a second line under the model name, which was adding a whole row of height to the header and pushing the table down. It rides inline after the name as (SL) sliding or (ST) steps, and hovering the tag gives the full sentence. The section info icon carries the same two tags.
TILT and HYBRID tabs: the RETURN caption stops saying FULL when IS, WF and LB are all ticked - at that point the tick already IS the full run, so naming it twice read as a fourth stretch.

TILT tab WIN %: the heat map was never broken. A tilt refuses no trades, so every column on that tab wins the exact same trades and only the size differs - the row reads one number all the way across and there is no spread to shade. The hover now says that outright instead of leaving it looking broken. The HYBRID tabs, which DO drop trades, shade normally.

TRADES and ALL TRADES now name their window - TRADES carries the stretches you have ticked, ALL TRADES is tagged FULL. Untick IS and the two separate by exactly the in-sample trade count, which is the whole of the difference. Re-sizing never moves either, so both read identical on HYBRID, HYBRID recycle and HYBRID equal-drawdown.
TRADE CANDLES: hover any candle and its numbers print under the title - time, Open, High, Low, Close (green or red), Volume and VWAP. Until now the only prices on the chart were the axis labels.
TRADES blotter (expanded 1A) now says CHAMPION CONFIG in its header line, and the candle window subtitle leads with it - those trades are always the crowned config, nothing else.

EQUITY COMPARE (expanded 2A) blotter columns: the header used to print a raw tag like #cfg7. It now reads config 7 - 2B RANK 7, because config 7 IS the RANK 7 column of the 2B CONFIGS card; hover the header for the reminder, and the PARAMS button lists that config knob values. (These three shipped inside 71.23 and are logged here.)

RUNBOARD matrix printed its band caption IDENTITY twice - once over the strategy / market / scope rows at the top and again over the lone verdict row at the bottom. The top block is headed RUN now and the bottom one VERDICT.

RUNBOARD matrix now opens in the 1E layout - metrics down the side, strategies across the top - regardless of what COMPARE own table is set to. The board keeps its own VERT / HORIZ pick, and that pick moved onto the matrix tile as a third tab rail beside SAMPLE and RANK.
RUNBOARD funnel: a gridline $ label that would land underneath a strategy ending-$ pill is no longer drawn, so the right gutter never shows two figures stacked on each other.
The wheel-zoom / drag-pan hint on the compare and runboard charts used to sit permanently on top of the date row. It fades in only while the cursor is over the chart now.
RUNBOARD funnel title no longer wraps onto a second line over the plot - the description truncates with the full text on hover.

1A FUNNEL: switching a key row off and back on no longer opens the expanded chart. Two clicks in the same spot is also a double-click as far as the browser is concerned, so toggling a line back on kept expanding the view. A double-click that lands on a control - a key row, a chip, a slider - is now ignored; the chart body still expands as before.

1A FUNNEL: the FULL RUN and GATE chips are off the top right. The stretch picker is the same saved setting as the SAMPLE tabs on 1E, and the GATE line has been switched from its own key row since 71.20, so neither chip was the only way to reach its setting.

1A FUNNEL DRAWDOWN was only ever the RAW champion, on a chart showing five books. It now draws one underwater line per family - RAW, GATE, TILT, HYBRID and HYBRID recycle - each in its own line colour, each hiding and showing with its own key row, and the pane stretches to whichever digs deepest so none of them is clipped.
PAST RUNS: the star column is squeezed to the width of the star. The shared table padding was giving a 12px glyph a 32px column.

PAST RUNS: NOISE was missing from the family chip row. It was not in the family table at all, so it had no number and no colour and got no chip in either view. It is family 12 now and the chip shows in the flat list as well as the grouped one.

RUNBOARD funnel now wears the 1A CHAMPION EQUITY look: a blue walk-forward band and a purple lockbox band shaded across the plot with in-sample left un-shaded, the IS / WF / LB labels printed inside the top of each region, a dashed purple door line, and each strategy ending $ pinned as a coloured pill on the right at its own line height.

RUNBOARD table rebuilt on the SAME matrix shell the 1E KPI MATRIX uses - grouped uppercase metric bands, the metric names pinned on the left while the columns scroll, one column per strategy in its curve colour, and the ranking leader tinted in its own hue.

SAMPLE and RANK moved ONTO the matrix tile as underlined tab rails - the same control look the 1E card uses, blue for SAMPLE and teal for RANK - instead of sitting in a separate strip above the board.
The MATRIX now sits to the RIGHT of the FUNNEL, the way 1A and 1E sit side by side in a run report, with the strategy list keeping the narrow left column.

RUNBOARD rebuilt in the 1A + 1E style: a FUNNEL chart (the same live equity overlay COMPARE uses - key pills on their lines, crosshair, drawdown pane, solid in-sample / dashed walk-forward / dotted lockbox) sits above a sectioned MATRIX (metrics as rows, strategies as columns, green best in row, VERT / HORIZ flip).
The board now POPULATES ITSELF with the top run of every strategy - the same champion rule BY STRATEGY uses - instead of a hand-pasted table.

SAMPLE (FULL / IS / LB) redraws the funnel curves, not just the numbers: IS cuts each curve at its first walk-forward fold, LB shows only the lockbox year with every curve rebased to zero. RANK BY (MAR / PF / NET / MAX DD) orders the funnel key, the matrix columns and the list, measured on the picked SAMPLE.
The pooled BOOKS table (the offline two-strategy book numbers) keeps its own clearly separated tile at the bottom - same SAMPLE and RANK BY picks apply.

ENSEMBLE is now SCALED OUT, everywhere the site names it. ORB 3.0-ENSEMBLE reads ORB 3.0-scaled out in past runs, the run header, rankings, the compare board, the library and every strategy dropdown. The old word was wrong twice over: this is one entry with two exit plans, not an ensemble of strategies, and the report already uses ensemble for its own top-K config blending.
Whole words in the branch tag are lower case now - scaled out, master. The true abbreviations keep their capitals because that is what they are: BE, 2L, TR, TS, BE-TRIG.
The lunch-trail sibling gets a proper tag too - it used to render as a bare ORB 3.0 with no branch at all.
Nothing about the strategy changed and no saved run was touched. The rename is display only, so every past run keeps its identity, its family number and its history.
Funnel key box nudged 5px down so it sits fully INSIDE the plot rather than starting in the boxs padding - at 4px its top edge was 2px above where the chart actually begins.

THE GATE CURVE WAS NOT BEING DRAWN AT ALL. It was only built when the GATE chip was on, and that chip is saved off - so the key box was listing a GATE line with a dollar figure while the chart had no such line on it. The curve is always built now and simply hidden when the chip is off, exactly like the config cloud and the walk-forward group, so one click on the GATE key row draws it. That row reads dimmed while it is hidden.

And the gate curve is RED now - line, key row, gutter pill and chip together. It used to be drawn in the same pink family as the two hybrid lines running beside it, which is a large part of why it could not be found.
FUNNEL KEY is ordered by where each line FINISHES, best first, instead of a fixed RAW / GATE / TILT / HYBRID order - so the key reads top to bottom the way the chart does.

IS / WF / LB are off the funnel. The blue fold stripes and the purple lockbox stripe already mark those stretches and hovering either now names it with its dates and its numbers, so the floating tags were saying a third time what the chart says twice.
And with them gone the funnel needs no headroom band: the key box sits at the top edge of the plot and the gap between the chart and the tile above it is closed.

TRADE CANDLES (71.16 follow-up, caught by looking at a real render): on a chart carrying more than one day, the day label and the nearest clock label were printing on top of each other - 15:30 and 04/08 landed on the same spot and neither could be read. The day label now wins and the clock label next to it stands down.

TRADE CANDLES: the VWAP line was joining one day close straight to the next day open, drawing a move that never happened. VWAP restarts every session, so the line now breaks at each day and draws one segment per session.

Follow-up to 71.17: closing the funnel pane gap had quietly handed those units to the drawdown pane and grown it 15 percent. The equity floor drops by the same amount, so the gap is the only thing that changed.

And with the panes adjacent, the drawdown zero label was landing on top of the equity zero gridline. It steps aside when a scale number is already there, the same way the gutter drops a number under a pill.

TILT and HYBRID now measure on the SAMPLE you tick, exactly like the ML GATE matrix. Every reward-versus-risk row, the drawdown row and the trade count were hard-wired to the lockbox, so ticking IS and WF changed nothing below the return block. They are now MAR, MAX DD, PF, WIN percent, DOLLARS PER TRADE and TRADES over whatever is selected, the ordering ranks on that same selection, and the group caption names it. A pick that skips a stretch - IS plus LB with no WF - has no single span to read a drawdown from, so that one cell prints a dash instead of a number that would not mean anything.
SIZING OVERLAY removed. It was a hand-rolled ORB contract-sizing card that rendered above every ORB report; sizing is read from the TILT and HYBRID tabs now.
FUNNEL: the IS / WF / LB row sits lower in the chart with the top inset grown to match, so the curves still never reach the tags.
FUNNEL: the dead band between the equity pane and the drawdown pane is down from 7 units to 3 - about the 5px breather 1A leaves.

FUNNEL: the two grey axis rules are gone. The chart reads off its gutter pills and its date strip, so they were chrome. The non-funnel TOP CONFIGS chart keeps its axis - it has no gutter to read instead.

TRADE CANDLES: every row of the TRADES blotter (inside the expanded 1A equity chart) now carries a candle button. Click it and the trade opens as a real price chart - that session of candles plus the session either side, the session VWAP, a shaded band over the bars you were in the trade for, and an entry arrow and exit dot at the fill prices. This is the first time EDGELOG draws a candle anywhere.

EXIT PRICE FIX: the blotter was printing the closing price of the exit bar as the exit fill. That is not the price the engine filled at whenever a trade exits on a stop, a target, or the next bar open - on ORB it was wrong on 3,397 of 4,065 trades. Exit price is now worked back from the trades own points and cost, which is exact. The blotter also carries LONG or SHORT per trade now.
Blotters saved before this fix still hold the old exit price. The candle chart says so in its subtitle when it sees one - Shift+click TRADES to regenerate it on your PC.
EXPANDED FUNNEL: the legend groups now read RAW, GATES, TILTS, HYBRID, HYBRID recycle and OTHER RAW - the same names as the tabs on the card, instead of ML GATES and SIZE TILTS.

EXPANDED FUNNEL: HYBRID and HYBRID recycle lines are IN there now. Every hybrid model draws its own line, plus a second line for the same book with the freed contracts put back to work, at the exact factor the HYBRID recycle tab prints. Both families start hidden and switch on from the key, like the gates and tilts.

FUNNEL KEY: the HYBRID recycle row no longer disappears on runs where the top hybrid refuses no trades. There is nothing to recycle on those runs, so the row prints the same figure tagged 1.00x and points at the hybrid line - it used to vanish entirely and read as a broken feature (run 201).

FIX on 71.13: the funnel high-water marks came out EMPTY on run 200. The test for whether a drawdown is deep enough to mark was 3 percent of the whole chart range, and the hybrid recycle line stretches that range to 1.16m - so the bar sat at 35k and the champion real drawdowns, which top out around 17k, all fell under it.
