The test now measures against the champion own curve, which is what 1A does.

FUNNEL drawdown pane rebuilt to the CHAMPION spec: the Monte-Carlo P95 floor and the realised worst drawdown now draw as dashed reference lines, the scale stretches to whichever is deeper, both get their own pill on the axis, and the pane sits on its own band so it reads as a separate pane. Same colours as 1A. The old DRAWDOWN and worst captions are gone because the pills carry the numbers.
FUNNEL high-water marks: a horizontal held at each running peak until equity recovers, so where each drawdown sits reads straight off the curve. 1A has drawn these for a long time.

FUNNEL band hovers: the walk-forward stripes carried a bare browser tooltip with nothing but a fold number and the lockbox stripe carried none at all. Both now open the same detail box 1A gives - dates, out-of-sample dollars, PF, trade count and the held or failed verdict.
FUNNEL dates print M/D/YY like 1A, and the LB tag carries the held tick or cross.
IS / WF / LB were sitting in the plot boxs padding ABOVE the drawing area on the funnel. They are inside the chart now, over its own background, the same place 1A draws them.

SIZING OVERLAY is collapsed to a single line. It renders on every ORB run and is an execution-layer side note rather than part of the report, so it no longer pushes the whole of section 1 down. Click the bar to open it and the choice sticks.

FUNNEL gutter width now follows its widest endpoint pill instead of a hard 44px. With five pills on the axis the longest was running past the edge and getting clipped - the recycled-hybrid pill lost its tag entirely. Short runs are unchanged because 44px stays the floor.

FUNNEL gutter: every family line now prints its ending PnL as a pill on the axis. TILT, HYBRID and HYBRID recycle were drawn on the chart and priced in the key box but had no pill, so only two of the five lines could be read against the scale. Pills are tagged T, H and H-recycle in their line colour, next to the existing crown, gate, IS and lockbox pills.

Those pills now hide when you click their key row off, and dim with everything else when you hover a different family - a dollar chip sitting on the axis with no line under it reads as a line you cannot find.

Put back the two things 71.9 changed for no good reason: the configs slider is 120px again and the evaluated-configs count always prints. 71.9 read the sample control as four separate chips being clipped, but it is a DROPDOWN - its options are text inside it, so nothing was ever hidden.
Kept from 71.9: the control row wraps rather than cutting, which is worth having on a narrow card.

FIX on top of 71.8: moving the configs slider to the left squeezed the funnel control row, and PRE-LB and LOCKBOX were being CLIPPED off the left edge of the sample tabs - the row was set to cut rather than wrap. It wraps now, so no control can ever be hidden.

Also bought the row some width back: a shorter slider track, and the evaluated-configs count prints only when it differs from the stored-curve count (on run 200 both read 77, so it was saying the same number twice).

1A now names the chart it is showing ON THE SAME ROW as the number - 1A CONFIG FUNNEL or 1A CHAMPION EQUITY, with the info icon beside it and the CHAMPION / FUNNEL tabs at the right. The chart name used to sit on a second line underneath, out of line with the 1A.
The door emoji is off the GATE toggle on both charts, and the funnel triangle is off the funnel title.
The configs slider moved to the LEFT end of the funnel control row - the sample tabs and the GATE toggle keep the right edge. On the CHAMPION tab the graph-detail slider leads its row the same way.

FIXED: a page refresh kept landing on COMPARE. A second browser tab left open on COMPARE was re-rendering on every data update and stamping ITS view over the one you were using. Only the tab you can actually see saves the view now.

Tabs everywhere now sit on a faint translucent background, a little stronger when selected, and each control group has its own tint - card views yellow, the IS / WF / LB stretch picker blue, the ordering picker teal, the shading toggle amber - so it is obvious which control a tab belongs to.
The heavy yellow bar under a selected tab is gone site-wide, and the yellow outline on the ranked row is softened to a hairline.

1E: the NO GATE baseline column is removed - shading now compares the gate variants against each other. The CHOSEN and WOULD PICK badges and the pink highlight on the winning column are gone too; the column order already says which one wins under the rule picked top right.
1E title compacted to free up width for the tab rail.

FUNNEL gets a HYBRID RECYCLE line. Redeploying spends the contracts the filter freed up, so the same trades carry more size - the dollars, the drawdown and where the book finishes all move, and that deserved its own line rather than being called a duplicate. It is drawn at the exact factor the HYBRID recycle tab uses on its FULL row, so the two agree.
The champion / funnel card carries its number again - 1A on the card, with CHAMPION and FUNNEL staying plain tab names inside it. Monthly P and L below it is 1B as before.

SAMPLE, RANK and HEAT now read as underlined tab rails matching the tab strip above them, highlighted when on. RANK no longer opens a pop-out panel - its three options sit inline like everything else in the row.
FUNNEL: the worst-drawdown figure moved up onto the drawdown pane top row, beside the DRAWDOWN caption, so it stops crowding the date ticks underneath it.

FUNNEL now runs on a real calendar. The lockbox door sits at its true share of the timeline instead of a fixed 84 percent - on run 200 that one lockbox year was taking 16 percent of the chart, nearly three times the time it covers, stretching it and squeezing the fifteen years before it. Same placement the CHAMPION chart uses.

FUNNEL date ticks were WRONG: they were pinned to fixed fractions of the window (37.5 and 75 percent), which stopped being true when the in-sample door moved to the real first-fold boundary - the tick reading Sep 2021 was sitting on the June 2016 door. Six ticks now, each placed at the x its own date maps to.

FUNNEL drawdown pane is sized like the CHAMPION chart - about a quarter of the plot instead of a sliver - and its captions plus the date ticks moved out of the stretched drawing layer into crisp text, so they stop looking squashed.

The two chart views carry no section letter any more - they are simply the CHAMPION and FUNNEL tabs. The 1A prefix is gone from the champion title and the 2A prefix is gone from the funnel title; everything else keeps its letter.

COMPARE has a third mode: RUNBOARD — compare whole BOOKS (deployable strategy combinations) instead of individual runs. Each row is one book scored as ONE strategy, with every leg trade pooled, so PF and MAR are true book numbers.
RUNBOARD: SAMPLE flips every column between FULL, IS and LB (the lockbox year), and RANK BY re-sorts on MAR, PF, NET or MAX DD. Both choices are remembered.
The STRATEGY column names the book (BLEND = two strategies side by side, 1 contract each) and the VERSION column says what is different about that book.

2A FUNNEL gutter pills, the REAL cause: a de-collide pass was pushing eleven pills 8 units apart so they would not overlap, which walked nine of them off the lines they label. Only the lines that are actually drawn get a pill now, so there is nothing to fan out and each pill sits on its line. Turning the full config cloud back on brings its pills back with it.
The 1E KPI matrix sits tighter vertically - the same padding rhythm the RAW and GATE matrices use.

NOISE 1.0 gained a protective stop (stop_mode / stop_k, default OFF so nothing changes unless you opt in). NOISE had no stop before this - only a VWAP cross - so a bad breakout could run a long way before exiting. The researched setting (bandwidth mode, k=1.0) lifts net 254.4k to 268.4k, cuts max drawdown 31.2k to 21.7k, cuts the worst single trade 15.5k to 4.7k, and MAR moves 8.14 to 12.39, reviewer audited pre-lockbox. This variant has NOT been tested on the held-out year - the lockbox for this family is spent, so it is paper-forward only. See BACKTESTING_STACK.md section 3 for the full record.
SECTION 1 is back to THREE columns - the equity/funnel card, the 1E matrix and its duplicate. The fourth column is gone.

The 1G / 1H / 1I / 1J distribution stack moved DOWN into section 2, which is now three columns again: distributions on the left, parameter panels in the middle, config-landscape panels on the right. In the 2x2 and single-column report layouts those three simply stack.

2A FUNNEL: the IS / WF / LB tags ride the very top edge of the chart like 1A, the key box sits directly under them at the top left, and a tag whose centre lands near the right edge now anchors to that edge instead of being cut off.

THE KPI TAB NOW AGREES WITH RAW AND GATE. Every column - IS, WF, LB and TOTAL - is rebuilt from ONE source: the champion own trade list, sliced at the real calendar boundaries. Net, trades, drawdown, profit factor and win rate all describe the same trades over the same dates.

What changed in numbers on run 200: IS net 56,814 becomes 52,053 (it was a residual, not a measurement), WF net 361,110 becomes 365,871 (the crowned config, not the re-optimising procedure), IS max drawdown 10,611 becomes 4,702 (it came from a third measurement), and TOTAL trades 3,948 becomes 3,952 (it was three counts from three backtests added together).
Each column drawdown is now the deepest dip INSIDE that stretch, and TOTAL is the deepest dip on the whole curve - so the drawdown row follows the section you are reading, exactly as the returns do.

NEW WF OOS chip on the 1E title row carries the walk-forward PROCEDURE result - the folds each re-picking their own config - so that number is not lost, it just stops being mixed into the champion column.
The Feasibility header chip counted a different trade set again; it now reports the champion own total.

DOCS: the visual PnL and price-action report is now specced - docs/VISUAL_TRADE_REPORT.md, with a working prototype promoted into the repo (docs/samples/noise_visual_report.html, tools/build_visual_report.py). No UI change yet - this is the build plan for a candle-chart view per trade, recommended Phase A next.
1E MATRIX is now DUPLICATED side by side - two identical cards, each remembering its own tab, so any two tabs can be read against each other without switching back and forth.

2A FUNNEL gutter pills were genuinely misaligned: the plot sits in a box with 6px of vertical padding, so the drawing area is 12px shorter than the gutter beside it, and the percent positions drifted up to 6px away from the line they label. Pills and scale numbers now share the same measuring box and centre exactly.
2A FUNNEL opens as one line per family - the grey cloud, the in-sample max and the other walk-forward survivors start hidden. Click the RAW key row to bring them back; the choice sticks.

Fix from the 70.4 merge: switching to the 2A FUNNEL tab was hiding 1B MONTHLY P&L, 1C WALK-FORWARD and 1D STRESS along with the champion chart. The tab now swaps ONLY the chart - the three panels below stay on screen on both tabs.
2A CONFIG FUNNEL now lives INSIDE the 1A card as a tab - 1A CHAMPION first, 2A FUNNEL second. It no longer takes its own column in section 2.
2B moved INSIDE the 1E card, and 1E became the first tab: KPI, RAW, GATE, TILT, HYBRID, HYBRID recycle, HYBRID falling-chart - seven tabs, one card.
1E money cells print in the same compact k format the config tabs use, so 56,814 now reads 57k. The exact dollar figure is on hover.

RECONCILIATION: the 1E IS cell is a RESIDUAL (total minus walk-forward minus lockbox), not a measured slice - its tooltip now says so and points at the RAW and GATE tabs for the exact calendar figure. The RAW MAX DD row is relabelled MAX DD IS+WF because it covers the optimize window only, while the GATE and KPI drawdowns include the lockbox.
2A CONFIG FUNNEL key rows renamed to match the new tab names - RAW, GATE, TILT, HYBRID. They still carried the old ML prefix and the retired 2D / 2E section letters.
2B tab labels shortened: RAW, GATE, TILT, HYBRID - the ML prefix is gone from the chips.

The three hybrid sizing views are three separate TABS now instead of a second switcher inside the card: HYBRID (one lot), HYBRID with the recycle mark (redeploy) and HYBRID with the falling-chart mark (equal drawdown). The active view is named on a chip under the table.
SAMPLE is no longer a drop-down anywhere. The IS / WF / LB chips sit inline in the control row and tick or untick on click. RANK stays a menu because it is a single pick with long labels.
2B CONFIGS is now ONE card with FOUR tabs - RAW CONFIGS, ML GATE, ML TILT, ML HYBRID. The separate 2D ML SIZING tile is gone; its two views became the last two tabs.

The tab strip sits hard right on the title row and SAMPLE / RANK / HEAT sit directly UNDERNEATH it, also hard right. On the ML HYBRID tab the ONE LOT / REDEPLOY / EQUAL DD switcher joins that same control row.

Every warning, chip and explanatory line moved BELOW the table: the ML GATE verdict chip, the COMPARISON ONLY badge and the one-line description of each sizing tab now sit under the matrix behind a divider, instead of crowding the title row.
The hide arrow is gone from 2B - the card is permanently displayed.

2B CONFIGS and 2D ML SIZING title rows: the controls, the tabs and the hide arrow now travel as one right-aligned group, so a narrow column drops the whole group to a second line still flush right instead of stranding the tabs on the left.
The ONE LOT / REDEPLOY / EQUAL DD switcher inside 2D ML HYBRID is drawn as tabs too, matching the section title row.

2E CONFIG DISTRIBUTION: found the real reason the IS MAX line could not be seen - on this run the walk-forward crown lands on the SAME config, so the green crown line was drawn straight over the blue IS MAX line at the identical dollar figure. When two marks coincide the line now SPLITS vertically: IS MAX takes the top half, the crown the bottom half, both at their true position, and the key says so.

The drag-to-resize handle bars in section 2 were dead - every one of them. Each tile there is wrapped in its own divider row, so the handle could not find the tile above it and the drag did nothing. All section-2 handles now resize their tile.
2B CONFIGS and 2D ML SIZING: the view switchers moved to the top RIGHT of the title row and are drawn as proper underlined TABS instead of a segmented toggle.

2D ML SIZING fits on screen again. The SIZE RULE row printed a full sentence per column on one line, which alone forced every column to about 170px; it now shows the shape and the cut-off, with the sentence on hover. SIZE MIX lost its thousands separators, and any matrix past 8 columns tightens its padding.
2E CONFIG DISTRIBUTION, 2F 3-D EXPLORER and 2L ML CONFIG BUILDER moved out of the middle column and now stack under 2K in the right column - the middle column is the two big tables alone.

2E CONFIG DISTRIBUTION: the mean, crown, IS MAX and sigma lines are SOLID instead of dashed, each with its own transparency - mean, crown and sigma are deliberately faint, IS MAX is the boldest so it is findable. The chart now draws a real bottom axis rule and the $ numbers under it are brighter on a taller strip.

2D ML SIZING: LB $ and FULL $ now stay on screen whatever SAMPLE is set to. Every reward/risk and sample row under them is measured on the lockbox, so hiding the LB return row left LB MAR and LB TRADES with nothing to reconcile against. IS and WF still follow the tick.

2D ML SIZING now runs the SAME SAMPLE / RANK / HEAT control kit as 2B CONFIGS, off the SAME saved settings - one tick moves all three sections. SAMPLE picks which of IS / WF / LB return rows show (FULL and the LB anchor rows always show); RANK orders the model columns by MAR, NET $, or NET $ with the 80% MAR floor, measured on the lockbox; HEAT shades every cell by where it lands across its own row.

Seven metric rows carried across from 2B into 2D: FULL $, FULL MAX DD, FULL MAR, SHARPE, LB PF, LB WIN % and LB $ / TRADE. FOLDS HELD is the one 2B row deliberately left out - a tilt is never fold-tested, so there is no honest number to print.

The REDEPLOY / EQUAL DD sizing factor is now computed PER SLICE instead of once on the lockbox and applied sideways to rows measured over other stretches. Every slice carries its own no-gate twin in the run doc, so IS, WF, LB and FULL each scale by their own exact ratio. MAR, SHARPE, PF and WIN % are scale-free and never move.

FIX: switching to the ML GATE tab in 69.4 blanked the report - the verdict chip was built inside an inner block the new merged header could not reach. The chip is now shared properly and the tab switches cleanly.
2B and 2C are now ONE section - 2B CONFIGS - with RAW CONFIGS and ML GATE as tabs in the title row, matching what 2D ML SIZING already does.

Nothing was dropped in the merge: each tab keeps its own info icon, its own sub-line, and its own SAMPLE / RANK / HEAT controls, and the ML GATE tab keeps its verdict chip, its pop-out menus and the cut-off sweep chart. The header shows whichever tab is active.
The hide arrow now collapses whichever tab is showing - RAW CONFIGS was previously always open with no way to fold it away.
2D and 2E are now ONE section - 2D ML SIZING - with ML TILT and ML HYBRID as tabs in the title row. Saves a whole tile of vertical space and puts the two side by side under one roof.
The ML HYBRID tab keeps its own ONE LOT / REDEPLOY / EQUAL DD strip, so you can tab to the hybrid and then choose how it is sized without leaving the section.
2E ML HYBRID: the REDEPLOY toggle is now a three-way tab strip - ONE LOT, REDEPLOY, EQUAL DD.

NEW EQUAL DD view: each column is sized until its LB drawdown matches the no-gate book, answering which variant makes the most money for the SAME pain. Unlike REDEPLOY it needs no historical keep-ratio, so it is the comparison that survives into live trading.
LB dollars, max drawdown, biggest size and average contracts all follow the selected tab; MAR stays fixed in every view because scaling multiplies profit and drawdown equally.

2C ML GATE gains a fixed LB TRADES row. The existing TRADES KEPT row follows the SAMPLE toggle so its meaning shifts as you tick stretches; this new one is always the lockbox year, which is the basis 2D and 2E report on - so all three sections can be compared without touching a control.
2D ML TILT and 2E ML HYBRID: the TRADES row was printing the whole-run count while every row around it was lockbox-only. It is now LB TRADES, with ALL TRADES kept as a separate row underneath.

NEW REDEPLOY toggle on 2E ML HYBRID. ONE LOT is the normal view - every column averages one contract per trade, so a variant that refuses trades leaves that capacity idle. REDEPLOY sizes each column up until it spends the same total contracts as the no-gate book, which is the what-if-I-put-the-freed-capacity-back-to-work question. LB dollars, max drawdown and biggest size all move with it; MAR never does, because scaling multiplies profit and drawdown equally.
NEW AVG CONTRACTS row in 2D and 2E showing the average contracts per trade each column runs - one in the normal view, and in REDEPLOY what the freed capacity buys.

2D and 2E: the DROPPED row is renamed NOT TAKEN, and its tooltip now says what actually happened - the cut-off refused those trades, so they were never entered at all: no position, no fee, no profit or loss. A tilt refuses nothing, so it always reads 0.

NEW SIZE RULE row in 2D ML TILT and 2E ML HYBRID: every column now states its own exact sizing rule and its own cut-off. Two rf columns can run two different shapes, so this can never be guessed from the model name - 2D reads no cut-off (a tilt drops nothing), 2E reads drops under 50 percent.
NEW DROPPED row: how many trades the cut-off threw away entirely. Tilts always read 0; hybrids show the real count.
SIZE MIX tooltip spells out the buckets: small is under 0.75 of a lot, medium 0.75 to 1.5, large over 1.5.
These three rows need engine data saved from this version on - reports made earlier show a dash.
2D renamed ML TILT and 2E renamed ML HYBRID - matching 2C ML GATE, fixed vocabulary from here on.

2D and 2E slimmed back down: the no-gate and crowned-gate baseline columns are removed (they kept reading as variants - the baselines live in 2C), the header annotations moved behind each section info icon, and column sub-labels are one word (sliding / steps) or nothing.

The 2E info icon now states the shared ratio once: every column uses the SAME pinned cut-off (the 2C crown, 50% on this run) and the same sliding sizing - only the scoring model differs between columns.

2D column headers say what they are in plain words: SLIDING SIZE (contracts slide smoothly with confidence, quarter-lot to triple) or 3 STEP SIZES (half / one / two lots by confidence band) - and each notes NO CUT-OFF, because a tilt never drops a trade, so there is no rf-at-50 to name.
2E hybrid headers name the pinned cut-off - gate 50% + tilt - so it is clear which gate the survivors passed.
NEW SIZE MIX row in 2D and 2E: how many trades were given a small (under 0.75 lot), normal (0.75-1.5) or large (over 1.5) size. The engine saves it from today - runs made before this show a dash.

2A: the key is the expanded-view style box inside the chart again, with exactly four rows - RAW, GATE, TILT, HYBRID - each showing its family top-line dollars. The default view draws ONLY those four top lines; clicking RAW reveals the rest of the config family (the survivors and the grey cloud), clicking again hides them.

2A: the drawdown now hangs DOWN from its own baseline exactly as 1A draws it - it was filling from the floor up, which read inverted. The dashed IS/LB divider lines are gone (the stripe colours already mark the sections), and the IS / WF / LB tags sit inside the plot.
2A: the best HYBRID (2E) draws as its own violet line on runs that carry hybrid data.
Named back to ML GATE everywhere, per the owner - 2C title, the 2A chip and key, the tilt texts, the Builder and run-list labels. One name, no more switching.

2A brought in line with 1A: horizontal gridlines gone, the IS / WF / LB tags are crisp HTML (they were being stretched with the chart), the stripes stop at the equity floor so the drawdown pane below stays clean, and the key moved OUT of the plot into a chip row above the chart reading crowned / RAW configs / GATE (2C) / TILT (2D) / DRAWDOWN.
2A crosshair works like a chart cursor now: a date label rides the bottom axis and a dollar label rides the right axis, with both hairlines - nothing floats over the curves.
2D SIZE TILT rebuilt as the same matrix shape as 2C - one column per variant, metrics as rows - and every held-out column is named LB.

NEW 2E HYBRID section: gate first, then tilt the survivors. The cut-off is pinned to the one 2C crowned, so it adds no new knob. Appears on runs made from today; older reports have no hybrid data saved.

The crown pool widened from the top-5 to the top-10 in-sample configs - still ranked by walk-forward, and the LB still never chooses. A config like number 5, strong on walk-forward but sixth-or-lower in-sample, can now compete for the crown instead of watching from the stands.
2B header labels aligned consistently.

2A cleanup pass on the owner punch-list: the drawdown is now its OWN pane under the equity with its own baseline and worst-$ label, exactly like 1A - it no longer sits inside the price section. The IS / WF / LB labels moved INSIDE the plot and IS is actually visible now. The best size-tilt line is included in the y-scale so it can no longer run off the top of the chart.
2A crosshair upgraded to 1A behaviour: the readout now shows the date, the champion equity dollars AND the drawdown dollars under the cursor, not just the date.

2A key renamed for clarity: best size tilt (2D) - the best row of section 2D, not the hybrid; other WF-tested configs - the configs that reached walk-forward testing but are not the crowned or in-sample-best line; 2C ML filter - the same thing section 2C crowns.
2B: the NOT ELIGIBLE columns now show their config numbers (a bookkeeping bug made them print a dash).

2C: the HINDSIGHT badge was firing on every new run even when the view matched the exact rule that crowned it - the rule name gained a suffix in v66.5 and the badge check was never updated. It now only appears when the view genuinely differs from the crowning rule or includes the LB.

2A CONFIG FUNNEL revamp (non-expanded): walk-forward folds now draw as alternating blue stripes exactly like 1A; a compact red champion-drawdown strip runs along the plot floor; the best SIZE TILT from 2D draws as its own amber line; a crosshair with a date readout follows the cursor; and every key row is live - click hides or shows that line, hovering spotlights it. FULL RUN is the default period, and the overlay chip says FILTER instead of gated.

Section 2 re-lettered so SIZE TILT is properly 2D: distribution 2E, param surface 2F, parallel coordinates 2G, PDP 2H, knob importance 2I, neighbours 2J, top configs 2K, ML config builder 2L. Every section-2 title now carries an emoji like 2C does.
2B and 2C title rows now end in the identical SAMPLE / RANK / HEAT controls - the hindsight warning moved out of the strip to a small note under the 2C matrix.
Expanded 2A: the OTHER CONFIGS group now states the split - 67 grey plus 10 coloured equals the 77 the tile reports - so the two counts stop looking like a discrepancy.
2B: hovering a NOT ELIGIBLE column rank now explains what that means - kept for context, never in the pool the crown picks from.

NOISE 1.0 added to the strategy library for backend testing - the wide-band intraday momentum envelope that passed walk-forward validation; ES-transfer caveat and unspent lockbox documented in the strategy file. Not a crowned strategy.
Wording: the word SKIP is gone from the tilt section entirely. The 2C model is called THE FILTER everywhere it is referred to, so the vocabulary never changes between sections.
SIZE TILT is its own section now (2D), directly under 2C, instead of being stacked inside it. The cut-off sweep stays in 2C where it belongs - it is a property of the filter, not the tilt.

Wording fixed throughout: the 2C model is called the FILTER everywhere, never a skip or a gate. The tilt info now spells out that both use the SAME score - the filter as a bouncer (trade does not happen), the tilt as a dimmer (trade happens smaller).

Cleared up the size contradiction: individual trades run from about half a contract to triple, and the AVERAGE across all trades is exactly one - that is the point, the tilt is the same size of book as no-filter, just spread differently. Half a contract is real: micros are one tenth, so half an NQ is five MNQ.
Every column in the tilt table now explains itself on hover - what IN-SAMPLE, WALK-FWD and HELD-OUT actually mean, and what BIGGEST SIZE measures.

2B now lists ALL the configs the engine evaluated, not just the five that could win. The engine always scored about ten; the display-only extras were computed and thrown away. They appear dimmed and marked NOT ELIGIBLE so the distinction stays clear.

2B: every listed config now carries a real held-out number. Previously only the top three by walk-forward were run through the held-out year, so most of the table had a blank there and could not be compared like for like.
Compare chart moved above the table, with the same bordered key box style as chart 2B instead of the old wrapping legend text.
The Compare chart is now interactive in place - crosshair with date and per-run values, wheel zoom, drag pan, double-click reset - no need to open fullscreen.
Compare table can flip between VERT (runs as columns) and HORIZ (runs as rows) so many runs fit without sideways scrolling.
Compare table dollars abbreviated (400k / 1.03M) with compact run headers.
Report columns re-ordered on owner request. Section 1: the KPI matrix moves to the MIDDLE column and the trade-distribution stack (1G-1J) moves to the right.

Section 2: the 2A funnel now owns the whole first column on its own. The middle column is 2B raw configs, the 2C ML filter, 2D distribution, 2E explorer and the 2K ML config builder. The third column is the parameter views - 2F through 2J.

1J TRADE CONTEXT was drawing its title twice, and listing every scanned feature made it a very tall tower. One title now, and the features that read no signal fold into a one-line expander at the bottom.
SIZE TILT table text shrunk - the shared table style was sizing those columns about twice as wide as their numbers need.

Challenger round 15: the GMM regime-state signals from the 2026 MNQ falsification paper do not replicate under causal reconstruction on 16 years of NQ - the fourth and final online sweep closes with zero strategies beating ORB. See BACKTESTING_STACK section 3.

SIZE TILTS are their own section in the 2A equity key now, instead of being buried inside ML GATES where they were unfindable. They are a different animal to a gate: a gate SKIPS trades, a tilt keeps every trade and only re-sizes it, so mixing them read as if the tilt lines were gate candidates. One toggle still shows or hides the whole tilt family, and the lines stay hidden until asked for.

Expanded chart view fits split-screen better: the title is smaller, the row gap tighter and the VIEW picker narrower, so the toggle labels (closed, trades and the rest) stop compressing and the header row no longer has to be scrolled sideways. The row deliberately stays one fixed-height non-wrapping line - letting it wrap re-flows the layout while the hover readout grows and resizes the chart under the cursor.
Compare gained a mode toggle at the top: PICK RUNS (the manual picker, unchanged, still the default) or BY STRATEGY (new).

BY STRATEGY shows one curve per strategy family - its top config, picked automatically by score, max 8 families - on the same equity chart, drawdown pane, metric table and net P&L bars as before, updating on its own as new runs land.
No manual picking in that mode - switch back to PICK RUNS any time.

Glass diet - the scroll lag fix, confirmed by the owner switching themes. Content surfaces (cards, sections, KPI strips, buttons, inputs) no longer run a LIVE blur on the six glassy themes - that was ~50 GPU re-blurs on every scrolled frame. The frosted look stays where it actually reads: the top bar, nav and pop-up menus keep their real blur, and cards keep their translucent tint, borders and depth shadows. Net effect: the glassy themes now scroll like the flat ones. If any card now reads too flat, say so - the tint can be warmed per theme.

Scroll-lag pass, no visual change. The pinned REPORT header was re-measuring and re-styling itself on every scroll tick — it now checks at most once per frame and only touches styles when its pinned state actually flips. The glass card themes were animating every style property; they now animate only the four that ever change on hover. Two scroll listeners marked passive so the browser never waits on them. The glass blur itself is untouched — if scrolling still feels heavy on the frost theme, that blur is the remaining cost and dialing it down is a look decision.

1J TRADE CONTEXT gained two honesty layers from the Carl feature-selection playbook. NOISE FLOOR: every scan now plants three fake features (real values shuffled across days) and a real feature must out-score the best fake to survive - the floor value shows in the panel footer, and a feature that cleared the old checks but not this one reads a grey at-or-below-noise verdict. JOINT MODEL: all features are also fit TOGETHER (sparse regression plus a forest, both against the same fake-feature floor), so overlapping features like VIX and volatility percentile stop double-counting the same story - features the joint model independently leans on get a blue diamond next to their name and a summary line in the footer. Runs launched before this update lack the new fields and simply render as before.

CHAMPION EQUITY (2A): the size-tilt variants now draw as their own lines, on the same chart as the no-filter champion and the skip-filter candidates - so tilt versus skip versus no filter can be read off one picture instead of three tables. They sit in the ML GATES legend group with the other filter lines, hidden until you toggle that group on, and are labelled tilt: model so they can never be mistaken for a crownable candidate.

ML FILTER (2C): a new SIZE TILT table under the matrix. The filter above SKIPS trades below its cut-off; these rows spend the very same confidence scores as SIZE instead — every trade still taken, bigger when the model is confident, smaller when it is not. Shows in-sample, walk-forward and held-out dollars, held-out MAR and max drawdown, and the biggest size any single trade got, against both the no-filter baseline and the crowned skip-filter.

Every tilt row averages one lot per trade over the tuning years, so it is the same size of book as the no-filter row — not a bigger bet. Marked COMPARISON ONLY: the engine can never crown one, and the pre-registered filter rule is untouched.
Costs nothing to compute — the tilt rows reuse the model scores the filter already produced, so no extra run time.
FIX: opening a run report failed to draw in 65.0 — the new 2B controls were referenced before they were defined. Reports render again.
2C: RECOVERY is now called MAR everywhere (same calculation, one name), and FULL RUN is now FULL
2C: the row the column order is reading is outlined in yellow, matching the now-yellow RANK BY control
2B: gets the same RANK BY and HEAT MAP controls on its title row, sharing one setting with 2C
2B and 2C: new $ / TRADE row — whether a config or filter makes money from better trades or just more of them
2C: SAMPLE gains IS and WF, slicing by the same calendar stretches 2B uses, so the filter and the ungated champion compare over matching dates (needs a re-run)
2C header tidied — the same sentence was printed twice and two chip rows said what the row colours already say
2A: SAMPLE picker on the funnel title row — dims the periods you are not looking at, and shares one setting with the 2C matrix
2C: heat map now shades the crowned column too (the crown tint was painting over it)
2C: MAX DD moved under the last equity row with a separator, instead of its own section; it follows SAMPLE
2C: added SHARPE, marked RECOVERY as the same calculation 2B calls MAR, and badged the row the column order is reading
2C: SAMPLE renamed PRE-LB, with an entry explaining why a filter cannot be split into in-sample and walk-forward
2B: MAR / SHARPE / MAX DD / FOLDS HELD now say which slice each one measures
engine: gate variants now save measured lockbox and full-run stats, and configs save their optimize-window profile — both need a re-run to appear
2C: on the LOCKBOX sample, a warning now says the marked drawdowns are read from about 18 curve points and understate — the dollars are exact, the drawdowns are indicative
2C: new SAMPLE control — drawdown, reward-risk and trades-kept rows switch between IS+WF, the held-out year, and the full run, so the periods are never ambiguous

2C: new RANK BY control — order the variants by recovery (the engine rule), by raw dollars, or by dollars among variants within 80% of the best recovery; a what-if winner is marked WOULD PICK and the crown never moves
2C: optional HEAT MAP shades every cell by where it lands across its own row
2B: reward-risk rows now say which slice each one measures — MAR, SHARPE and MAX DD were three different windows with no label
gate quality bar removed — the lockbox block above it already says the same thing in more detail
2C matrix rebuilt to match 2B/1E: return rows are now IS+WF $ / LB $ / FULL RUN / MAX DD, in blue and purple period colours
2C shows every gate variant lockbox $, not just the chosen one — read off the saved curves, marked with a degree sign, and it still plays no part in choosing the winner
gate quality bar is back: the before/after GATE EQUITY bars now draw on every gated run instead of only on older runs with no saved curve

1J TRADE CONTEXT now guards against a trap: a feature that drifts over years (10-year yield, yield curve, VIX level) can look strongly linked to performance simply because BOTH it and the strategy changed over the decade. Every feature is now also tested INSIDE individual years, and its confidence range is widened to account for market conditions persisting for months. Anything that only correlates across eras is rejected and labelled trend artifact in yellow, with the year-by-year strength shown on hover. Real example caught: yield curve looked highly significant across 16 years of ORB trades, yet the link vanishes within any single year.

FIXED the ML gate line on the 2A chart disagreeing with the fullscreen view. On 2A the tuning window is stretched across most of the width and the held-out year gets the rest, but the gate line was being spread evenly across the whole width — so it was showing an earlier point in time than the config lines beside it and drew too low through the middle. It is now split at its own held-out boundary and mapped onto the same stretches, so both views agree: the gate runs above the ungated champion.

FIXED a wrong number in 2B CONFIGS RAW: the TOTAL row was adding in-sample plus walk-forward plus lockbox, but those cover overlapping stretches and the lockbox figure is already the running total — so a config whose real full-run result is 485k was showing over a million. It is now a FULL RUN row that matches chart 1A and the crowned line in 2A, the LB row shows only what the held-out year itself added, and dollars are abbreviated so the table is as compact as 2C.

2B CONFIGS RAW listed MAX DD twice — once under TOTAL and again as its own section. The duplicate section is gone; the drawdown now sits directly under the total, so profit and the risk taken to get it read together.

CONFIGS · RAW (2B): column headers now read RANK 1, RANK 2 and so on instead of the confusing WF1/WF2 prefix (the crown still marks the winner). The walk-forward and lockbox return rows are tinted with the same blue and purple used for those periods everywhere else in the report; in-sample stays plain. Added a TOTAL row (in-sample plus walk-forward plus lockbox, or just the first two — starred — when a config never reached the lockbox) with max drawdown repeated directly under it so profit and the risk taken to get it read together. The reward-versus-risk group now also shows a derived Sharpe ratio, how many walk-forward folds each config held, and profit factor / win rate whenever a run actually saves them — never invented when it does not.

ML FILTER CONFIGS (2C, was CONFIGS · ML GATE FILTER): simplified header with one short line underneath instead of scattered text, and a duplicated lockbox chip removed. The tile now runs in clear order: the matrix of all 9 model and cut-off combinations, headed PRE-LOCKBOX and spelled out plainly as in-sample plus walk-forward combined, then a separate purple LOCKBOX block below it showing only the winning combination final-year numbers, held out and untouched until now (no-gate versus gated: net dollars, profit factor, trades, max drawdown) — those held-out numbers can no longer be mistaken for the ranking numbers above them. Dollars are abbreviated and columns tightened so the matrix fits the screen without side-scrolling.

Each ML model (random forest, gradient boosting, logistic regression) now gets its own color family in the 2C matrix column headers and in the funnel chart lines above, instead of every model sharing one shade of pink — the same color now means the same model in both places, and the winning combination stays the most vivid shade of its own color.

Configuration Analysis section: CONFIGS · RAW now has its own bordered tile (it used to render as a bare table hanging under the funnel chart above it) — the funnel, the raw configs and the ML gate filter now read as three separate tiles in a row, the same way they render everywhere else in this report.

Both CONFIGS · RAW and CONFIGS · ML GATE FILTER now lead with a side-by-side matrix in the same style as the KPI MATRIX in Strategy Performance — one column per config or gate variant, with the crowned or chosen one highlighted, and the numbers grouped into return, drawdown, reward-versus-risk and sample sections; for CONFIGS · RAW the knobs that differ between configs are now their own rows, so the differences line up straight across. The ML gate matrix shows immediately now instead of being hidden behind the collapsed HOW IT WAS CHOSEN section. Both matrices scroll sideways inside their own box when there are many columns, with the metric names staying put on the left.

The COLUMNS control drag handles for resizing tile widths now keep working in the 2x2 layout (each row of two tiles can still be resized against each other), not just in the 3-across layout; the 1-column layout still has nothing to resize, so its handles stay hidden there.

NEW: a COLUMNS control sits next to REPORT LAYOUT at the top of a run report — pick 3 (the current side-by-side default), 2×2 (two tiles per row) or 1 (every tile stacked full width), useful on a narrower laptop screen. It applies everywhere the report lays out multiple tiles side by side, not just one section. Below roughly 700 pixels wide the report always shows as a single stacked column regardless of the pick, and the width-drag bars and per-column collapse arrows — meaningless once a tile fills the whole row — step aside in 2×2 and 1 (they return in 3).

The CONFIGS · RAW table in Configuration Analysis now fills in MAX DD and MAR for every row, worked out from the equity curve saved for each config instead of showing a dash. The PF and WIN % columns are gone — they genuinely cannot be worked out from a curve alone, so a column of permanent dashes was removed rather than kept.

Reorganised the CONFIGURATION ANALYSIS section of the run report: every tile now reads A through K in one consistent order, with two new tiles — a plain table of the raw crown-pool configs (promoted out of the funnel chart) and a renamed, relettered ML gate-filter tile.

The gate before/after numbers and its candidates table now each carry a clear coloured label naming which time period they measure (the held-out lockbox year vs the multi-year selection window), so the two can no longer read as a contradiction.
Long explanatory paragraphs moved into the small info icons, leaving at most one short line on screen per tile.
Each of the three columns in this section can now be collapsed to a narrow strip and restored, to make room for whichever one you are reading.

The fullscreen equity explorer TRADES button now works for each of the coloured survivor configs on the config chart - click it to pull the trade list for that specific config. The grey cloud and ML-gate lines still cannot be regenerated (that needs the model, which only runs on the server), and now say so plainly instead of a confusing error.

Explorer legend: the small expand arrow on each group is now a bigger, obvious button; the old line-style key (in-sample / walk-forward / lockbox dashes) at the bottom is gone; and the two separate info icons merged into one.
Explorer: the long list of every line value at the top on mouse-hover is gone - each line still shows its own value next to its name in the legend.
Explorer header buttons are now grouped left to right by purpose (view controls, then params and trades, then reset and close) with small dividers between them, instead of scattered in one row.

The SELECTION DETAIL table under the config chart now sorts by walk-forward result - the number that actually decides both the crown and the lockbox carry-through - with clear WALK-FORWARD RANK and CONFIG NUMBER columns and a note explaining the sort.

The ML gate candidates table is now a full side-by-side matrix (model, cut-off, trades kept, net dollars, a derived max-drawdown figure, profit factor, win rate, recovery) with the chosen candidate clearly marked and the whole table labelled pre-lockbox.

The chosen ML gate line in the 2A key now names itself — it reads the winning model and cut-off (for example "random forest at 55 percent - CHOSEN") instead of just "gate-kept", so it is obvious which of the nine variants actually won.

The fullscreen equity explorer legend is now three collapsible groups — CONFIGS, ML GATES, OTHER CONFIGS — each collapsed to one row by default with an arrow to expand into its individual lines. Clicking a group row toggles that whole family between full, dimmed and hidden together, the same three-step click every individual line already had.

The walk-forward survivor config lines now share one teal/green family of shades, with the champion staying the brightest, instead of a different colour per line. The ML-gate candidate lines now share one pink/magenta family instead of a colour per model, so the chart reads as clear colour groups at a glance.
Config line labels dropped the walk-forward dollar figure from the always-visible text — hover a line to see it.
Removed the separate ML GATES header button now that the legend group does the same job in one place; the gate candidate lines still start hidden and the chosen gate line still starts visible.
Removed the small navigator strip under the fullscreen equity explorer chart — it was too big and cluttered for what it did.
Removed the LOG axis-scale option from the fullscreen equity explorer — the dollar axis is plain and linear only now.

Combined the RANGE and WINDOW dropdowns in the fullscreen equity explorer into one VIEW dropdown, grouped into a date-range section (last 1/3/5 years, custom) and a stage section (in-sample, walk-forward, lockbox).

NEW 1J TRADE CONTEXT panel, under 1F REGIME REPORT CARD: it asks which market conditions actually explain a strategy performance. Each feature (VIX level and term, 10-year yield and curve, daily RSI, MACD, volatility percentile, trend strength, overnight gap, prior-day return and range, up/down streak) is measured on the PRIOR day, so it was knowable before the trade, then scored against every trade net dollars. The bar is the correlation (green = trades did better when that feature ran high, red = worse), the faint band behind it is the 95% confidence range, and a feature only reads helps or hurts if it survives a false-lead check that accounts for testing many features at once. Most rows SHOULD say no signal — that is the check doing its job. Runs launched before this update have no panel; new Auto-Validate, Auto-Optimize and Grid runs carry it.

The ML gate now saves an equity curve for every one of the 9 candidates it tests (each model type at each of the three cut-offs), not just the one it picks — the losing candidates still never reveal their sealed holdout numbers, only their curve.

The fullscreen 2A config explorer can now show all 9 of those ML-gate candidate lines, in a pink/magenta family of colours grouped by model — off by default so they do not clutter the chart, with a small "ML gates" button in the header to show or hide them all at once, and a collapsible legend row to reveal and toggle each one individually.

Added a compact slider to the fullscreen explorer header for how many of the faint grey "other tested config" lines are drawn, matching the same control already on the small in-page chart. Older runs made before this change simply will not show the new gate-candidate lines or button until re-run.

The crowned config and two others were showing as "config ?" in the 2A key — the stored config curves are rounded to whole dollars, so they never matched exactly. The matching now allows for that rounding, so every line names its real config number.

Every line in the 2A key is now named by WHICH CONFIG it is in the run config list — "config 33", with the crowned one as "👑 config 43" — instead of invented rank words. The full set of tested configs is back too: the old duplicate-filter was quietly hiding about 21 of them, so the grey cloud now shows every remaining config, each keeping its own config number.

Fixed a real accuracy bug in the fullscreen equity explorer: the faint grey cloud of other tested configs was squeezing its whole 15-year curve into the much shorter in-sample stretch, so those lines shot up to roughly the full backtest total right at the in-sample door instead of showing their true, much lower, in-sample value. The cloud now stops honestly at the door with the correct number.
Fixed the fullscreen explorer highlighting a random nearby line even when the cursor was nowhere close to any curve — it now only lights up a line when the cursor is genuinely near it.

Renamed the confusing legend labels in the fullscreen explorer: the winning config now reads "champion", the other configs that competed for the crown read "runner-up 2", "runner-up 3" and so on, and the extra context-only configs read "robustness line" with the "not in crown pool" text removed.
Fixed a stray floating dot left over in some fullscreen-explorer legend rows.
Added a small info icon at the top of the fullscreen explorer legend explaining what champion / runner-up / robustness line / other configs mean, in plain language.
The small 2A chart on the run report now draws its grey "other configs" cloud noticeably darker — it was there before but nearly invisible.

Fullscreen equity explorer: added the rest of the chart-viewer feel — arrow-key pan and zoom, a LOG button for a log dollar scale, a FIT Y toggle to lock or auto-fit the dollar range to what is on screen, and a small navigator strip under the chart for jumping around the whole timeline at a glance.

Config numbering in the expanded 2A view is fixed again: lines are now ranked ONLY among the configs that actually competed for the crown, so the three carried through the lockbox read WF #1, #2 and #3. The extra robustness lines — shown for context but never crown-eligible, and never carried into the lockbox — are labelled "extra" instead of being given a misleading rank.

Fullscreen equity explorer: moving the cursor over the chart now shows each line’s value AT THAT POINT right next to its name in the key, not just in the readout at the top — easier to compare several lines at a glance. The numbers clear when the cursor leaves the chart, and a line with no data at that point (like a config that already stopped) shows a dash instead of a misleading number.

Config lines in the expanded 2A view are now numbered by WALK-FORWARD rank (WF #1, WF #2, …) instead of an in-sample ordering. That was why the three configs carried through the lockbox showed up as crowned / rank 3 / rank 5 and looked wrong — they were always the correct top 3 by walk-forward, just mislabelled. They now read WF #1, #2, #3.

Fixed a real accuracy bug in the fullscreen equity explorer: the lockbox boundary was being placed years off the true date because every line spread its points evenly across the whole date range instead of its own real calendar span — lines that legitimately stopped right at the lockbox door were being drawn as if they kept going through it.
The walk-forward and lockbox shaded bands in that same explorer now line up with the real calendar dates instead of an approximate position.

Brought back the faint grey cloud of every other tested config in the fullscreen explorer (previously only the surviving few showed), collapsed into one legend row so the legend does not flood with entries.
Fixed legend hovering in the fullscreen explorer: hovering a line in the legend now highlights exactly that line instead of jumping to whatever line happens to be nearby.
The RANGE and WINDOW jump-to controls are now small compact pills next to the other header buttons instead of two full-width bars.
Removed the horizontal dashed reference lines that were cluttering the equity pane.
Added a PARAMS button to the fullscreen explorer that opens a table comparing every visible config’s settings against the winning config, highlighting what differs.
Fullscreen equity explorer: the walk-forward and lockbox stretches are now shaded on the chart itself (blue / purple bands with IS-WF-LB labels), matching the small 2A chart.
Added RANGE (all, last 1/3/5 years, custom dates) and WINDOW (all, in-sample, walk-forward, lockbox) dropdowns above the chart to jump straight to a stretch instead of hand-zooming.
Hovering the chart now thickens whichever line is closest to the cursor and fades the rest, with the matching legend entry outlined, so a crowded multi-line comparison is easier to read.
Removed the extra dashed reference lines that were cluttering the drawdown pane.
iPad/touch: one-finger drag pans, two-finger pinch zooms, dragging the $ axis scales it, and double-tap resets — the chart no longer fights the page scroll while you interact with it.
The 2A explorer legend no longer shows a meaningless "#" number in front of labels like "crowned" or "gate" — real run numbers (Compare tab) still show their #.

The expanded 2A explorer now plots against a REAL DATE x-axis instead of percent-of-progress — each config carries its own date span, so a config that stops at the lockbox door honestly draws no line past it.
Legend entries are named by what they mean: "👑 crowned · WF $x" and "rank 2 · WF $x" (the walk-forward $ each was judged on) instead of cfg1 / cfg2.

Double-clicking the 2A config chart now opens the FULLSCREEN explorer (the same TradingView-style zoom / pan / drag-the-$-axis viewer the Compare tab uses) instead of a flat blow-up — every top config gets its own coloured, separable line, each carried through the lockbox, and the gate curve rides along too. That fixes the lines being unreadably overlaid when expanded.
The crowned lockbox pill now shows a 👑 instead of a third identical 🔒.
Dropped the "solid IS · dashed WF · dotted LB" line from the 2A key — it ate space; the same explanation is still in the title info icon.

SECTION 2 re-lettered in reading order: the ML TRADE FILTER (the gate), which sits second, is now 2B (was 2J); the rest shift up one — config distribution 2C, explorer 2D, parallel-coords 2E, PDP 2F, knobs 2G, neighbour 2H, top configs 2I, ML config builder 2J.
The gate before/after now reads as a MATRIX (metric · before every trade · after gate kept), like the 1E KPI matrix, instead of arrow tiles.
2A: the other two lockbox survivor lines are now on the same TRUE-total footing as the crowned line, so the crowned no longer looks artificially lowest.

The 2J ML TRADE FILTER before/after cards now say WHICH slice they measure (e.g. "on the lockbox — the held-out slice"). The before number is that slice with every trade — so compare it to the SAME column in the 1E matrix (lockbox), not the in-sample column.

2A now agrees with 1A on two things: (1) the walk-forward boundary sits at the REAL first walk-forward test start (same date as 1A’s first blue band), not a fixed 75% split; (2) the crowned line ends at the champion’s TRUE full-run total (the 1A number), instead of the slightly-overshooting saved lockbox curve. So the crowned $ on 2A now matches 1A.

The 2A key now shows each line’s END value (carried through the lockbox), not its value at the walk-forward door — so the crowned line reads its true final $, matching where the line actually ends on the chart.

Family run ids now also show in COMPARE (the run picker + each comparison column header) and in the Library run list — matching Past Runs and the run-report header. New runs get their family id stamped automatically by the PC runner from now on.

The pink GATE-KEPT equity line now overlays the 2A chart on ENSEMBLE runs too (e.g. #175) — before it only drew on the walk-forward FUNNEL, so ensembles (no survivor pool) never showed it on 2A. The "🚪 gated" toggle + a gate-kept endpoint label now appear on the TOP-CONFIGS chart as well. The gated curve is folded into the y-scale so it never clips.

NEW family run ids: every run now carries a stable per-family number alongside its run # — ORB-1..8, TTIBS-1..9, ENGU-Q-1..7, etc. Shown under the run number in Past Runs and next to REPORT: in the run header. It never renumbers (deleting a run leaves a gap); references stay put.

FIXED: the pink GATE EQUITY curve was missing on ENSEMBLE runs (e.g. #175). The 2A funnel only overlays the gate curve when it renders as a walk-forward survivor FUNNEL; an ensemble has no survivor pool, so the overlay was silently dropped even though the 300-point curves are saved. The 2J ML TRADE FILTER pill now draws the FULL gate curve itself (every trade grey vs gate-kept pink) whenever the 2A funnel cannot host it — so the curve shows regardless. Normal validates are unchanged (curve stays on 2A, no duplicate).

2J ML TRADE FILTER now shows a GATE EQUITY visual on EVERY gated run — including older ones. Runs made before v64.13 carry the gate numbers but not the saved equity CURVE, so the pink path could not draw on the 2A funnel; those runs now get a before/after ENDPOINT bar (every trade vs the trades the gate kept) drawn from the totals they DO carry, labelled "endpoints only" with a re-run note. Runs that carry the full curve are unchanged (pink path on 2A).

2B marker honesty: the champion marker and key entry were hard-coded to say "crown", so a run with NO walk-forward crown pool still claimed a crown it never earned. The label now follows the data — 👑 crown when it really came from the crown pool, ★ champion when it is just the in-sample champion.

2B CONFIG DISTRIBUTION now marks the champion on runs that have no walk-forward crown pool (ensemble / deploy-book runs like #175, which previously showed no marker at all). The fallback was reading a field that saved run docs never carry, so it could never fire. It is labelled honestly: "👑 crown" only when it really came from the crown pool, otherwise "◆ champion" for the in-sample champion.

COMPARE ▸ PICK RUNS group view: opening a strategy now lists its runs by RUN NUMBER, newest at the top, so the most recent work is what you see first. The tile header still reports that strategy best run.
Removed the "find run #" search box added in 64.58 — not what was wanted.

FIXED the real reason switching COMPARE tabs changed nothing: a tab opened with ＋ fell back to showing "the latest 3", and the first run you clicked was toggled against that fallback — so the new tab silently absorbed those 3 default runs. Every tab therefore ended up holding the same comparison. An empty tab now stays empty (it shows an EMPTY COMPARISON TAB panel) and picking a run adds only that run, so each tab keeps its own set.

COMPARE grouping now matches the Past Runs group view — grouped by strategy FAMILY + VERSION ("7 · ORB 3.0"), so all the ORB 3.0-x branches file under one tile instead of every variant file making its own group.

COMPARE now has a real TOTAL scope — the whole run end to end (in-sample + walk-forward + lockbox), the same figure as the TOTAL column in a run report KPI matrix, with indented rows splitting it into the three stages.

The old "OVERALL" button was renamed IN-SAMPLE, because that is what it always showed: the champion measured on the window it was tuned on. The scopes now read IN-SAMPLE · WALK-FORWARD · LOCKBOX · TOTAL, matching the run report.
COMPARE ▸ SETS: saved comparison sets can be RENAMED — click the ✎ on a set chip (or double-click the chip). Clicking the chip still loads the set, ✕ still deletes it.

COMPARE: "clicking a tab or set changes nothing" is now explainable — each TAB chip lists the run ids it holds (so two tabs carrying the same runs are obvious), the set already on screen is highlighted blue with a ▸, an empty tab says it is falling back to the latest 3, and saved runs that no longer exist are called out instead of being dropped silently.

Fixed the big empty space under the 2J filter pill — it had inherited a stale fixed height from when it was a card in another column, so it now fits its content. Added slim drag-handle rows above and below it, matching the chart tiles; you can also drag its bottom edge to resize.
The 2J ML TRADE FILTER pill under 2A now opens by default (collapsed-by-default looked empty). Its before/after numbers and evidence show right away; the header still collapses it.

The 2J ML TRADE FILTER graph is gone — its equity curves now live on the 2A funnel (crowned = ungated, pink = gated). The rest of 2J (the before/after numbers + evidence) is a COLLAPSIBLE pill that sits directly under 2A; the verdict chip shows even when collapsed. Click the header to open it.

2A funnel: the crowned / IS-max / gated $ values no longer print on the chart itself (they were duplicated) — every endpoint value now lives only in the gutter, including the gate-filtered total and the IS-max total.

Compare fullscreen explorer: the drawdown pane now leaves a small gap above the bottom axis instead of the deepest line sitting flush against it, and the pane can be dragged noticeably smaller.

Compare fullscreen explorer: once trades are loaded, the chart now sits at a fixed height you can drag to resize, the trade blotter flows below it at its full natural height, and the WHOLE explorer scrolls as one page instead of the blotter having its own inner scrollbar.

Compare fullscreen explorer: fixed the trade blotter column header so a narrow column no longer crops the expand button, and widened the compact columns so entry date, dollar amount and running total no longer run together.

Fix: the best of each confirm dialog rows rendered as bare checkboxes (the app-wide input width stretched each checkbox across the whole row, shoving the run name and $ out of the card) — checkboxes are now fixed-size so every row reads name, run number and net $.
Compare fullscreen explorer: the drawdown pane is now resizable (drag the divider between the two panes) and each strategy drawdown is filled in its own colour, not just outlined.
Compare fullscreen explorer: click a legend chip to cycle that strategy full - greyed - hidden - full, so a crowded overlay can be thinned out without deselecting it from Compare.

Compare fullscreen explorer: the x-axis now shows real calendar dates under the percent ticks (once a blotter or run date range is available), the axis strip is drag-to-scale like TradingView, and hovering the $ axis, the pane divider, or the x-axis now shows the matching resize cursor.

Compare fullscreen explorer: the trade blotter panel scrolls as ONE piece instead of each column separately, columns default to a compact view (# / entry / $ / cum $) with a button to expand to all 7 columns, columns are drag-resizable, and each column plus the legend now shows its instrument and timeframe.
Compare fullscreen explorer: each strategy curve gets a dashed reference line at its final $ with a right-edge label, and the equity/drawdown panes read as more clearly separate panels.
Compare · best of each now opens a confirm step listing every pick and its net $ before touching your selection, with ADD (merge) and REPLACE (swap) instead of overwriting instantly.

Compare equity lines were confusing because the walk-forward dashes were drawn ON TOP of a solid line of the same colour, so the gaps just showed solid underneath. Each curve is now drawn as three NON-OVERLAPPING segments — SOLID in-sample, DASHED walk-forward, DOTTED lockbox — so the styles actually read, with a real visual key (line samples, not a sentence).
Compare fullscreen explorer: added a DRAWDOWN pane under the equity pane (each strategy drawdown-from-peak in its own colour), and % ticks + gridlines on the x-axis so you can tell where you are.

Compare fullscreen explorer: click-drag now pans cleanly like TradingView (it no longer fights text selection), and the crosshair reads the drawdown value (labelled dd) when the cursor is in the lower pane.
Compare fullscreen explorer: the trade blotters now show ALL selected strategies SIDE BY SIDE (one column each) instead of one tab at a time; click any row to fly the chart to that trade.
Compare line styles redone per owner: SOLID = in-sample, DASHED = walk-forward, DOTTED = lockbox — consistent across the overlay, its legend, and the fullscreen explorer, at sane line thicknesses.

Compare fullscreen explorer: once trades are loaded, win/loss trade dots now sit ON the curves (like the 1A chart) when zoomed in enough to read them — click a dot to jump to that trade in the blotter.
Blotter table cleanup: compact dates (MM/DD/YY HH:MM, and exits on the same day show just the time), HOLD column labelled in bars with the stray b suffix dropped, tighter columns so everything fits.
Compare table: the IS chip was lit but coloured so grey it read as OFF — now blue, clearly showing in-sample ran.

Compare fullscreen explorer: new TRADES button loads every selected strategy trade blotter off your PC runner — one colour-keyed tab per strategy, click a row to fly the chart to that trade. Compare: the PICK RUNS list has a ▦ GROUP toggle — the same by-strategy grouping as Past Runs (collapsible strategy tiles, champion first, with a selected-count per group); rows inside stay click-to-toggle checkboxes.

§2 config space: the 2C PDP mini-charts nest directly under 2B again (one subtile, tucked under the axis labels) — the separate 2C header that split them apart is gone.

2B parallel-coordinates: while you drag a brush over a range on an axis, the exact sampled values inside your selection are now labelled right on that axis (e.g. 3, 4, 5), live as you drag — so you SEE the data points you are highlighting.

§2 config space: the "HIGHLIGHTING" text strip that sat between the 2B parallel-coordinates chart and the 2C PDP row is gone — they now read as one tight subtile, with the 2C · PDP header restored above its row and each peak label centred over its own mini-chart.

2B parallel-coordinates now draws the actual config DATA POINTS as dots on every axis: brush an axis and the in-range points light up while the rest dim, so you SEE which configs you are selecting (not just a highlight band). Works in the ⛶ expanded config-space view too.
Run report §2 config-space widened — 2A/2B/2C now get more room; the 2C PDP mini-charts are taller and tucked up tight under 2B.
2C mini-charts no longer repeat each param name (the 2B axis above already labels the column); a small "2C" tag sits beside the row.
2A "top configs" chart: brighter/whiter gridlines, dropped the extra left guide line, single neutral NET axis.
2B parallel-coords: while you drag to brush an axis, a live HIGHLIGHTING readout lists each knob's selected range + the exact step values, so you can see what you're selecting.
⛶ on 2B now opens an EXPANDED config-space view (2B + the 2C PDP row together) that stays fully brushable — highlight axes right in the big view.

NINJATRADER AUTO-SYNC panel now shows a capture heartbeat: "capture alive Xs ago" (green) when the NinjaTrader AddOn is running, or "capture stale/missing" (yellow dot) when it stopped reporting — so a silently dead fill capture (e.g. after a broker reconnect) is visible instead of hidden.
Pairs with AddOn v2 (tools/EdgeLogExport.cs): it re-subscribes after every reconnect and back-fills any missed fills from the current session within ~60s.
2A equity overlay: y-axis $ labels shrunk + greyed to match 2B.
2B/2C now share one combined subtitle (they read as one config-space card).
Past Runs STRATEGY dropdown: new "contains" search box — type e.g. "orb" to filter the list, then "✓ select all shown" to add every match to the filter.

FIX: opening a run report crashed with "plotR is not defined" for runs with top-config equity curves (e.g. #137) — a leftover variable from the v50.6 2A chart alignment. 2A renders again; its hover crosshair now maps to the aligned axis span.

FIX: Past Runs list could appear EMPTY — the v49.5 per-column filter menus persisted an exclusion list ("Clear" hid every value) in browser storage. Those menus are removed; the previous behavior is back (click a column header to sort; MODE/MARKET/TF dropdown filters; the color-coded STRATEGY dropdown with multi-select). Any stored filter state is wiped automatically — your runs were never deleted.

Run report §2: new CHART METRIC toggle (NET $ / MAX DD / MAR ×100) above the parallel-coords — plots every param chart (2B·2C·2H·2I·2J) by drawdown or MAR instead of PnL, so risk levers like be_after_R become visible (they look flat on the PnL axis).
MAX DD view shows negative $ (greener = smaller drawdown); MAR is ×100 so the $ scales keep precision ($2,150 = MAR 21.5).
Needs per-config drawdown, recorded by the engine from this build — older runs show a "re-run to record it" note. Restart the local runner (EdgeLog) once so its jobs pick up the new engine.
Import/Export now has a WEBULL AUTO-SYNC panel next to NinjaTrader — last sync, trade count, live account balance, and a ✓ reconciled / ⚠ out-of-sync check against your broker positions.
New "Sync Webull now" button pulls today's trades on demand (the automatic pull runs once a day to protect the free Firestore quota).
NinjaTrader status now labels its count "in file" — round-trips in the rolling fills.csv on your PC, NOT your full journal total (older trades already synced are safe).
1G / 1H distributions get a scope picker — walk-forward (out-of-sample) / lockbox / whole run — and now DEFAULT to out-of-sample. Re-run a validate to populate the new walk-forward + lockbox slices.

Gate-validate: added a bake-off graph (recovery factor by probability cut-off, one line per model) so the repeated rf / xgb / logistic rows read as ONE model swept across cut-offs; the chosen winner is ringed.
1C walk-forward: the ANCHORED / ROLLING badges are now the fold-chart toggle — click a scheme to draw its folds.
2A top-configs now lines up with 2B: RED = leftmost param axis, YELLOW = NET axis, plus gridlines through the chart and smaller $ labels. 2C PDP nests under 2B with condensed peak labels.
2J 3-D scatter no longer crops at the top / back. Chart heights you drag now persist as your default. The Past Runs list uses the full screen height (was capped at 520px).

Charts re-lettered in true reading order (top→bottom, left→right): §1 col A is now 1A/1B/1C/1D (stress), col B 1E/1F, col C 1G trade-dist / 1H MAE-MFE / 1I deflated Sharpe. §2: left stack 2A/2B parallel-coords/2C PDP · right stack 2D distribution/2E correlation · 2F top configs · 2G neighbours · 2H+2I surfaces · 2J 3-D scatter.
§2 restructured like §1: one master tile stacking 2A → 2B → 2C with minimal spacing, and a right column tile with 2D + 2E.
Resizing is back everywhere: drag the grip on any chart to shrink/grow it, and the §1/§2 tiles themselves resize vertically too.

Sliders now FILL to the end at 100% (custom track), 2J 3-D scatter back to solid green/red dots (no more grey wash) and width-capped so it fits on screen, 2I has clear column dividers between Pearson / MI / PPS, 2F (top-configs table) got column separators.

2G 3-D scatter rebuilt to look like a real 3-D chart: shaded gridded floor, translucent back walls with $-gridlines, dots coloured on the red→green ramp and SIZED by |net $| with depth dimming, stems to the $0 plane — and the frame no longer crops the bottom. Same treatment in the orbit view.

§2 polish: 2A+2B boxes equal height; 2C $ labels sit next to the NET $ axis; 2K header slimmed (details on hover) and tucked under 2C; 2I got real column headers (PARAM · Pearson r · MI · PPS) and a sane width; 2E is a labelled table (−1 step · winner · +1 step per knob) with a how-to-read line; 2D headers truncate with hover for the full name; 2H subtext moved into ⓘ.
1E KPI header is ONE line with uniform readable pills (PASS/GATES/DSR/CALMAR).

Runs now store the top 50 config curves (was 24). 1D/1G show a "🔒 lockbox view · re-run to enable" hint on runs that predate slice data. Sliders share one style, and the expanded-1A chart/blotter split (orientation + size) persists as your default.

1D / 1G: real x-axis tick values (per-trade $ / signed points), the axis caption text is gone, the mean line is labelled, and stop/target labels ride their dashed lines. NEW dropdown on the tile: 🔒 lockbox (out-of-sample) vs whole run — new/re-run validates DEFAULT to the lockbox view (older runs stay whole-run until re-run).
1C: new/re-run validates also save the NON-selected walk-forward scheme's folds — chips on the chart flip between ANCHORED and ROLLING for comparison (the verdict still uses the stronger one).

2A: runs now store the top 24 config curves (was 12); the slider spans exactly what's stored, defaults to 20 coloured, and de-selected curves grey out instead of vanishing. Title subtext moved into the hover ⓘ so the slider sits inline and 2A/2B line up.
2C: the config count sits inline after the title and the axis labels render at a sane size at full width. 1A GRAPH DETAIL slider: live % label and a finer 5% floor.

Expanded 1A glitch fixed: the hover readout used to lengthen (…· lockbox) and wrap the header taller, resizing the chart under your cursor — the header is now fixed-height so the chart never jumps while you zoom/scroll.

Expanded 1A blotter: newest trades on top by default; click any header for a Past-Runs-style menu (sort ↑/↓, plus winners-only / losers-only on the $ columns). HOLD now shows a real duration (e.g. 11h 0m — bars × the run's timeframe, session time).
Expanded 1A layout: ⿰ SIDE / ⿱ STACK toggles the chart|blotter split (side-by-side or stacked), and the divider between them drags to give either tile more room.
2G 3-D scatter: the floor is now a shaded, gridded plane with a $ axis pole (peak · $0 · trough ticks) — same in the orbit view.

1A inline: the IN-SAMPLE / WALK-FORWARD / LOCKBOX labels moved to their own strip ABOVE the plot (they were sitting on the curve's final rally — run 150), and the curve's FINAL $ is pinned on the y-axis as a coloured tag (TradingView last-price style).

1A expanded: drag the $ axis up/down to compress/stretch the y scale (double-click or ↺ resets to auto-fit); the DRAWDOWN pane now reads as its own pane (tinted strip + label); the title shows the strategy's display name.

Blotter: NEW FEE $ column (per-round-trip commission+slippage — PTS/NET are already after it) and a HOLD ⓘ tooltip (bars held, in the run's timeframe). Loading the blotter now also swaps the chart to the FULL per-trade line — zoomed in, the equity line connects dot-to-dot instead of the averaged ~400-point curve.
2G / orbit view: every dot gets a thin stem down to the $0 plane so height differences read at a glance.

2C ⇄ 2K linked brushing: drag a range on any 2C parallel-coordinates axis and the SAME value range lights up as a blue band on that parameter's 2K PDP mini-chart below — see instantly whether the configs you kept sit on the paying part of the knob's curve. Clears when the brush clears.

(The 49.9 update pill arrived without bullets because the OLD page code drew it — from this update on, the what-changed list shows.)
Update alert: the green "new version" pill now shows a quick what-changed bullet list (pulled from this changelog) — not just the version number.

2G SCATTER is 3-D by default: every tested config as a dot in space (two params on the floor, its net $ as the height, dashed rhombus = the $0 plane, champion flagged). ⛶ opens the same drag-to-orbit view as 2H/2J; the ▦ 2D chip brings back the flat scatter with density contours + multi-compare.

2C parallel-coordinates axes now follow the 2K influence order (the knob that swings the most $ sits leftmost), and each 2K PDP mini-chart sits EXACTLY under its own 2C axis (with a NET $ column closing the row). 2I param correlation moved up to sit right under 2K.

Blotter fix (run 137): when a strategy file was renamed/deleted, the runner now rebuilds it from the run's stored code snapshot — the exact source that run executed — and regenerates the blotter from that.

3-D param surfaces: 2H and 2J now sit SIDE-BY-SIDE, both 3-D by default, each on its own parameter pair (2J defaults to the 3rd × 4th knob and hides when a strategy has under 3 params — no duplicate views). ⛶ on either opens a DRAG-TO-ORBIT view: click-hold and turn the surface to see behind ridges, wheel = height exaggeration, double-click = reset.
2K PDP top-out curves moved directly under the 2C parallel-coordinates chart (same card) — the per-knob read of the config space 2C fans out. Hover any dot for the exact value / avg $ / config count.

Expanded 1A: date-axis labels were clipping off the bottom — fixed (plus a right axis spine). Blotter loads now work for OLD runs whose docs carry the strategy display name, and giant blotters cap at the most recent 6,000 trades (full CSV stays on your PC).

1A CHAMPION EQUITY: the ⛶ expand now opens a full TradingView-style explorer — mouse-wheel zooms around the cursor, drag pans, double-click resets, the y-axis auto-fits the visible slice. Real date/$ tick axes, a crosshair with values pinned to both axes, and the drawdown pane below (red dashed = realised max DD, yellow dashed = Monte-Carlo P95) all ride along. Walk-forward bands + lockbox shading stay visible while zooming.

2H HEATMAP now has a ◱ 3D / ▦ 2D toggle — flip the same param landscape between the flat colour grid and the 3-D surface (2J stays).

1G MAE/MFE: the suggested stop/target dashed lines are now actually visible (thicker, brighter, halo-backed labels, edge-clamped).

Charts: the drag-to-resize grips are replaced by a single ⛶ expand button (bottom-right of every chart, incl. 1A/1B). Expanded charts show a live crosshair readout of the exact date/$ (or fold/window/pts) under the mouse.

Past Runs: EVERY column header now opens a Google-Sheets-style menu — Sort A→Z / Z→A plus a "filter by values" checklist where all values start CHECKED (all shown) and you uncheck to hide. Includes Select all / Clear, a search box, and colored strategy rows. Consistent across all columns; the menu drops below the header and no longer covers the list.

Fix: Auto-Validate lockbox & whole-run Sharpe / Sortino / avg-win / avg-loss were double-counting fees (the trades were already net of cost, then cost was subtracted again). These now read correctly on NEW / re-run validates — expect slightly higher Sharpe and avg-win, slightly smaller avg-loss. The equity curve, PnL, PF and drawdown were already correct.

Auto-Validate is now more comprehensive (applies to NEW / re-run validates once the runner restarts): (1) 4-WAY ML GATE BAKE-OFF — it runs the champion ungated + logistic / Random-Forest / XGBoost gates × cut-offs, ranks them pre-lockbox and gives the winner one lockbox look; the report tells you which it chose and whether it held. (2) WALK-FORWARD now runs BOTH anchored (expanding window) and rolling (fixed window); the stronger scheme drives the verdict and a badge on the fold chart shows which won. (3) NEW overfit gate — PBO (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, CSCV): how often the in-sample-best config lands below the out-of-sample median; complements the Deflated Sharpe. (4) Adversarial regime-drift + VIF collinearity surfaced as explicit checks.

Past Runs: clicking the STRATEGY header now opens a proper dropdown BELOW it (color-coded to each strategy) — it no longer covers the run list. The dropdown does both: a "sort by strategy" row AND per-strategy show/hide checkboxes. Other columns still sort on click.
Auto-Validate KPI matrix: rows grouped into sections (return · drawdown · reward÷risk · edge · sample) for easier reading.
Added a CALMAR pill (CAGR ÷ max-drawdown-%, last 3 yrs, $100k account) next to the DSR pill.
Past Runs: click the STRATEGY column header to open the multi-select filter (pills appear above the list, stay open, toggle which strategies are shown). Other column headers still sort as before.

NEW: Backtest ⇄ TradingView / NinjaTrader reconciler (Settings ▸ GENERAL ▸ OPEN RECONCILER). Paste an exported trade list and the runner reruns the same strategy on your master and diffs it trade-for-trade — matched %, total-PnL Δ, and an auto-diagnosis (tz/DST offset, fees, ETH-vs-RTH, contract rolls, entry-fill model, side flips). Distinct from the Webull fills badge — this is backtest-vs-platform parity.

Past Runs strategy filter moved into the header as a "▦ strategy ▾" pill picker — it no longer opens a dropdown that covered the run list. Pills sit above the table, stay open for multi-select, and the table filters live.
Past Runs strategy filter: the picker now STAYS OPEN so you can select several strategies in one go (it used to collapse after each click).
KPI matrix: added SORTINO (downside-only risk — does not punish big winners) and a true MAR (ann.) on a $100k account.
The dollar net÷drawdown ratio is now labelled RECOVERY (factor), distinct from true MAR.
Past Runs: filter by MULTIPLE strategies at once (pick several, removable chips).
Past Runs: table header stays fixed while you scroll.
Settings: new CHANGELOG sub-tab (this list).

Runner sync now preserves the archived flag across restarts.
MAR / MAX DD use drawdown magnitude (max_drawdown is stored negative) so risk-adjusted numbers read correctly.
Per-section MAR and MAX DD columns in the Auto-Validate KPI matrix.
2C parallel-coords header aligned with 2A/2B so the charts line up.
